66337.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量成熟顆粒球的核葉呈分離的小圓球狀，葉與葉之間以極細長的絲狀染色質相連（B 圖最明顯），伴隨骨髓性增生，這是 myelokathexis 的典型型態，配合臨床長期中性球低下應想到 WHIM 症候群（CXCR4 突變）。
features: Numerous mature neutrophils with nuclear lobes that are round, pyknotic-appearing and widely separated
Abnormally long, thin, filamentous chromatin strands connecting the nuclear lobes
No true hyperlobulation beyond what is expected; cytoplasm shows normal pink secondary granulation
Hypercellular aspirate with myeloid hyperplasia and a full spectrum of granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms)
Occasional basophilic precursors/plasma-like cells; erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages not distorted in the field
66337.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald Giemsa) is hypercellular with myeloid hyperplasia and orderly granulocytic maturation. Many mature granulocytes show nuclei composed of discrete, rounded, condensed lobes joined by abnormally long, thin filamentous chromatin bridges, without overt hyperlobulation or hypogranularity. Blasts are not increased in the fields shown. In the setting of lifelong neutropenia, these findings are consistent with myelokathexis, suggestive of WHIM syndrome (confirmed by CXCR4 mutation in this case).

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils are large with ≥6 normally connected lobes and accompanied by megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, rather than few round lobes on long filaments.

MDS shows hypogranular cytoplasm, pseudo-Pelger-Huët or abnormal segmentation with dysplasia in other lineages and often clonal abnormalities, whereas myelokathexis has well-granulated cells with thread-like interlobar bridges and negative MDS molecular testing.
Apoptotic neutrophils have dense, homogeneous, fused round nuclear fragments without chromatin filaments and are sparse, not a dominant population in a fresh hypercellular marrow.
These show normal-appearing neutrophil nuclei with maturation arrest or normal marrow, lacking the distinctive filamentous interlobar strands.

65697.recognize_zh: 淋巴結髓質與副皮質被纖維血管背景中的三系造血細胞取代、皮質被擠壓，高倍可見成群、核深染且怪異的非典型巨核細胞（CD61 陽性），伴 CD71 紅系、MPO 髓系細胞與網狀纖維增生；型態與同一病人的骨髓骨髓纖維化相同。
features: Low power: lymph node with distorted architecture, pink fibrovascular tissue replacing medulla and paracortex and compressing residual cortex
Clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bizarre, cloud-like or hypolobated nuclei
Admixed erythroid and granulocytic precursors in a fibrotic, vascular stroma
CD61 highlights clustered megakaryocytes; CD71 marks erythroid clusters; MPO shows scattered myeloid cells
Reticulin stain shows dense diffuse fibrosis in the node
Marrow panels: hypercellular fibrotic marrow with atypical megakaryocytes, increased reticulin and trichrome-positive collagen
65697.describe_en: Axillary lymph node shows distorted architecture with the medulla and paracortex replaced by a fibrovascular proliferation containing trilineage hematopoietic cells, compressing the residual cortex. There are clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bizarre nuclei that are CD61-positive, together with CD71-positive erythroid clusters and scattered MPO-positive myeloid cells; reticulin stain shows marked fibrosis, and CD34+ blasts are not increased. The concurrent bone marrow shows similar atypical megakaryocytes with reticulin and collagen fibrosis. Findings are consistent with lymph node involvement by primary myelofibrosis (neoplastic extramedullary hematopoiesis) with a mutational profile matching the marrow.

ddx.vs: Bizarre megakaryocytes can mimic pleomorphic tumor cells, but here they are CD61-positive and accompanied by erythroid and myeloid precursors rather than keratin-positive cells.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ and CD61-negative, set in an inflammatory rather than trilineage hematopoietic background.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of sheets of CD34+/CD117+ or MPO+ blasts, whereas blasts are not increased here.
Reactive EMH has cytologically normal megakaryocytes without clustering or dense fibrosis and lacks clonal MPN mutations.

65697.stain: H&E; IHC: CD61, CD71, MPO; reticulin; trichrome

65505.recognize_zh: 油鏡下 mucicarmine 染色，大小不一的圓形酵母菌外圍都有鮮洋紅色的莢膜環，部分菌體周圍還有放射狀淡紅暈；菌體散在於淡色組織球之間，下方有深紫色淋巴細胞群。洋紅色莢膜是 Cryptococcus 的決定性特徵。
features: Round yeast forms of variable size with bright carmine-red mucicarmine-positive capsules
Capsular material forms sharp rings, some with a fuzzy radiating pink halo
Occasional budding and collapsed/folded yeast forms
Organisms lie within and between pale vacuolated histiocytes
Dense cluster of small dark lymphoid nuclei at the bottom of the field
65505.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy, mucicarmine stain under oil immersion, shows numerous round yeast forms of variable size within and between pale vacuolated histiocytes. The yeasts have mucicarmine-positive, carmine-red capsules forming sharp rings, some with a radiating halo, and occasional budding forms are present; residual lymphocytes are seen at the lower edge. Findings are consistent with cryptococcal lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Blastomyces may show faint mucicarmine staining of the wall but lacks a thick capsule and shows broad-based budding.
Histoplasma yeasts are much smaller, uniform and mucicarmine negative.
Capsule-deficient strains may be mucicarmine weak, in which case Fontana-Masson (melanin) positivity supports Cryptococcus.
Signet ring cells contain intracellular mucin with a compressed nucleus and are keratin positive, unlike extracellular capsule-bearing yeasts.

65377.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、細胞質淡藍灰並向四周伸出細毛狀突起，是毛細胞白血病中的毛細胞。
features: Single medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus
Homogeneous chromatin; nucleolus not discernible
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Thick-area background of closely packed red cells
Only one cell shown at moderate magnification; fine detail limited
65377.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at moderate magnification shows a single medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, homogeneous chromatin and pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine hair-like projections around the circumference. No other leukocytes are present in this field, and the thick smear area and magnification limit assessment of nuclear detail. Findings are suggestive of a hairy cell; in the context of lymphocytosis with numerous such cells, hairy cell leukemia is favored and should be confirmed by flow cytometry and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: Cells show a prominent nucleolus and are CD25 and ANXA1 negative with wild-type BRAF.
Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and a phenotype lacking CD103 and CD123 co-expression.
Artifactual projections in thick areas occur on otherwise normal small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm.

65313.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片細胞密度極高，以顆粒球系增生為主，其間散在多群淡粉紅色、細胞質豐富且帶纖維紋理的大型組織球，即假性高雪氏細胞；配合 BCR::ABL1 陽性，符合 CML。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with no residual fat in this field
Granulocytic hyperplasia with numerous myeloid precursors and maturing forms
Clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pink fibrillary cytoplasm (pseudo-Gaucher cells)
Scattered small hypolobated megakaryocyte-like cells
Mildly fibrotic streaming stroma at the right edge of the core
65313.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia composed of myeloid precursors and maturing granulocytes. Scattered throughout are clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. Blasts are not evidently increased at this magnification, and a CD34 immunostain would help assess blast percentage. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with pseudo-Gaucher cells, supported by the positive BCR::ABL1 FISH.

ddx.vs: Gaucher disease lacks the granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1 fusion and is confirmed by low glucocerebrosidase activity.
These may be hypercellular with granulocytic predominance but show dysgranulopoiesis or monocytosis and are BCR::ABL1-negative.
Leukemoid reactions lack BCR::ABL1, small hypolobated megakaryocytes and basophilia.

65185.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中小型成熟淋巴球聚集，cyclin D1 與 SOX11 核陽性，符合套細胞淋巴瘤；流式顯示兩群 CD5+ B 細胞（kappa 亮與 kappa 暗），IGHV 定序熱圖出現兩個不同的主要重排（VH3-J4 與 VH3-J5），證明為雙株（biclonal）MCL。
features: Bone marrow biopsy with an interstitial/nodular aggregate of small mature lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei among fat spaces and megakaryocytes
Cyclin D1 nuclear positivity in a subset of the lymphoid aggregate cells
SOX11 nuclear positivity in the lymphoid cells
Flow cytometry: CD19+/CD20+ B cells with CD5 expression forming two populations, one kappa-bright (clone 1) and one kappa-dim (clone 2), lambda negative
IGHV-IGHJ NGS heat map with two dominant rearrangements: IGHV3-J4 (clone 1) and IGHV3-J5 (clone 2)
65185.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with scattered aggregates of small mature lymphoid cells that express nuclear cyclin D1 and SOX11. Flow cytometry identifies two aberrant CD5-positive B-cell populations with similar phenotypes that differ in kappa light chain intensity (bright versus dim). Immunoglobulin heavy chain NGS demonstrates two distinct dominant productive rearrangements (IGHV3-9/IGHJ4 and IGHV3-15/IGHJ5) with differing somatic hypermutation status. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by biclonal mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Composite CLL/SLL and mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: A CLL clone would be CD23+/CD200+ and cyclin D1/SOX11 negative, whereas both populations here share a CD5+ cyclin D1+/SOX11+ phenotype.

ddx.dx: Single MCL clone with class switch or intraclonal light chain variation
ddx.vs: Clonal evolution shares the same IGHV-IGHJ rearrangement, whereas two different V-J rearrangements with different mutation status indicate independent clones.
CD5+ MZL lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11 and IGH::CCND1 rearrangement.
Benign aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, mixed T and B cells, and cyclin D1 negative.

65185.stain: H&E; IHC: cyclin D1, SOX11; flow; NGS

64993.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片中腎小管被大量間質內的小型淋巴樣細胞分隔撐開，小管上皮變扁平、部分管腔內有管柱與脫落物，顯示腎小管損傷；此倍率看不到腎絲球或明確濾泡結構，淋巴瘤診斷需靠免疫染色（CD20、CD10、BCL2）確認。
features: Core biopsy fragment with tubules widely separated by a dense interstitial cellular infiltrate
Infiltrate composed predominantly of small, monotonous round to slightly irregular lymphoid cells
Tubular injury: flattened or simplified epithelium, dilated lumens and intraluminal casts/debris
No glomeruli and no distinct nodular or follicular architecture identified at this power
Loose, edematous interstitial stroma between infiltrate and tubules
64993.describe_en: Renal core biopsy sections show limited renal parenchyma composed of tubules separated by a dense, diffuse interstitial infiltrate of small monotonous lymphoid cells. The tubules show acute injury with epithelial flattening, luminal dilatation and scattered intraluminal casts. Glomeruli are not present in this field and a follicular pattern is not appreciable at this magnification. The findings represent an interstitial lymphoid process; immunohistochemistry demonstrating a CD20+/CD10+/BCL2+ B-cell population is required to establish renal involvement by follicular lymphoma and to exclude reactive interstitial nephritis.

ddx.vs: Interstitial nephritis contains a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, neutrophils, plasma cells and tubulitis, whereas lymphoma is a monotonous B-cell infiltrate that expands the interstitium.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma involving kidney
ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is CD5+/CD23+/CD10- and may show proliferation centers, requiring immunostains to separate from follicular lymphoma.
IgG4-related disease has storiform fibrosis and abundant IgG4+ plasma cells rather than a monotonous small B-cell infiltrate.
MZL cells are CD10-/BCL6- with monocytoid or plasmacytoid features, distinguished from FL by immunohistochemistry.

65121.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指兩個大型漿細胞核偏心、圓形、染色質呈車輪狀，細胞質豐富，中央偏灰藍而外緣呈鮮明的粉紅至洋紅色（左側細胞尤其明顯），右側細胞邊緣有粉紅色小泡狀突起；這種外緣紅染的「火焰細胞」（flame cell）來自免疫球蛋白堆積，旁邊兩個分葉嗜中性球可作大小對照。
features: Two large plasma cells (arrows), considerably larger than adjacent segmented neutrophils
Eccentric round nuclei with clock-face (cartwheel) coarse chromatin, without prominent nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm with a blue-grey granular central zone and a peripheral pink-magenta rim (flame appearance)
Right cell with irregular cytoplasmic margin showing small pink blebs of cytoplasmic material
Two segmented neutrophils for size comparison; background RBCs and scattered platelets
65121.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large plasma cells flanked by segmented neutrophils. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that is blue-grey centrally and transitions to an intensely pink-magenta peripheral rim, with small pink cytoplasmic blebs at the margin of one cell. These represent flame cells, reflecting accumulation of immunoglobulin, often IgA. Flame cells are not specific for neoplasia; the finding is consistent with flame cells in the reported plasma cell myeloma, with the diagnosis resting on plasma cell burden, clonality and clinical criteria.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (infection, chronic inflammation, autoimmune disease)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells can also show flame morphology but are polyclonal by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry and usually form less than 10% of marrow cells.
Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale immunoglobulin globules rather than a diffuse pink peripheral cytoplasmic rim.
Early granulocytes have a paranuclear Golgi zone and discrete azurophilic or specific granules rather than clock-face chromatin and a pink-rimmed agranular cytoplasm.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation.

64929.recognize_zh: 箭頭處的紅血球比周圍正常紅血球大、顏色較淡，內含形狀不規則的阿米巴樣（amoeboid）寄生蟲，帶一顆紅色染色質點，胞質內可見細點狀薛氏小點（Schüffner dots），符合間日瘧（P. vivax）滋養體。
features: Single infected red cell enlarged and paler than surrounding uninfected erythrocytes
Irregular, amoeboid trophozoite with scattered blue-purple cytoplasm
Distinct magenta chromatin dot
Fine pink-purple stippling of the host cell consistent with Schüffner dots
Background erythrocytes normocytic without other parasites in this field; occasional platelets
64929.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a background of largely normocytic, normochromic erythrocytes. A single enlarged, pale red cell contains an irregular amoeboid trophozoite with a prominent chromatin dot and fine cytoplasmic stippling of the host cell (Schüffner dots). No banana-shaped gametocytes or multiply infected cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium vivax trophozoite.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum rings are small and delicate in normal-sized red cells without Schüffner dots, often with multiple or appliqué forms, rather than a large amoeboid trophozoite in an enlarged cell.
P. ovale also enlarges the red cell with Schüffner dots, but the host cell is typically oval with fimbriated edges and the trophozoite is compact rather than amoeboid.
P. malariae infects normal-sized or small red cells without stippling and forms compact or band-shaped trophozoites.
A superimposed platelet lies in a different focal plane, has no halo of host-cell enlargement, and lacks a discrete chromatin dot with parasite cytoplasm.

64737.recognize_zh: 低倍下幾乎整片腫瘤細胞都呈棕色陽性，陽性以細胞質內點狀、顆粒狀為主，均勻遍佈全片，顯示瀰漫的 CD138 表現，支持腫瘤由漿細胞構成（漿細胞瘤）。
features: Diffuse positivity in virtually all tumor cells across the field
Staining is predominantly dot-like to granular cytoplasmic rather than crisp membranous at this low power
Monotonous, densely packed cell population without intervening negative tissue
Occasional thin vessels and small empty spaces
64737.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry at low magnification shows diffuse positivity in essentially all cells of the tumor sheet. The staining in this image appears as fine dot-like or granular cytoplasmic positivity of moderate intensity rather than the strong membranous pattern usually seen, which may reflect fixation or the low magnification and should be interpreted alongside the positive and negative controls. Supported by the plasmacytoid morphology on H&E, the findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm; kappa/lambda restriction studies are recommended to confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: CD138 also stains many carcinomas, so keratin negativity and light-chain restriction are needed to confirm plasma cell origin.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or ALK-positive large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are also CD138 positive but show large blastic cells with prominent nucleoli on H&E, a high Ki-67 index, and EBER or ALK positivity respectively.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed with other inflammatory cells and are polytypic for kappa and lambda rather than forming a pure monotonous sheet.

64673.recognize_zh: 周邊血液拼圖中多顆中等大小的淋巴球，細胞質深藍、核偏位且染色質較粗，部分可見核旁淡染區（hof），形態像漿細胞，屬病毒感染（水痘）時的反應性漿細胞樣淋巴球。
features: Medium-sized lymphocytes with moderate amounts of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with moderately coarse, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleoli
Occasional faint perinuclear clearing (hof) imparting a plasmacytoid appearance
Population is morphologically heterogeneous, mixed with small lymphocytes and normal neutrophils
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytic artifact) and adequate platelets
64673.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite) shows increased reactive lymphocytes, many with a plasmacytoid appearance: medium size, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin, and occasional perinuclear hofs. The population is heterogeneous, admixed with small mature lymphocytes and unremarkable neutrophils, and blasts are not seen. Red cells show crenation artifact. In a child with varicella, findings are consistent with reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytosis secondary to viral infection.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell leukemia / circulating myeloma cells
ddx.vs: Circulating clonal plasma cells are more uniform, frequently show a well-defined hof, nucleoli or atypia, occur in adults, and show light-chain restriction.
LPL cells are a monotonous clonal B-cell population with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, not a heterogeneous transient reactive population in a febrile child.
EBV-reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and peripheral basophilia rather than compact deep-blue plasmacytoid cytoplasm.
Lymphoblasts have fine dispersed chromatin, high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm, unlike these condensed-chromatin cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm.

64545.recognize_zh: 鼻腔抹片中可見兩個上皮細胞，細胞質淡藍、蒼白略呈泡沫狀，圓核偏向一側；但杯狀（cup-like）外形與分泌黏液在此圖中不明顯，辨識需搭配檢體來源。
features: Isolated epithelial cells with moderate amounts of pale blue, faintly vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Single round nucleus with speckled, finely granular chromatin, eccentrically placed in the right cell
Distinct goblet (cup/chalice) shape and apical mucin vacuole not clearly appreciable
Mucoid, finely granular pink-purple background with debris
Refractile brown particle next to the left cell, likely exogenous debris
Image focus and resolution are limited
64545.describe_en: Nasal smear stained with a Romanowsky-type stain shows scattered epithelial cells in a mucoid, granular background. The cells have a single round nucleus with speckled chromatin and pale, faintly foamy blue cytoplasm; in one cell the nucleus is displaced toward one pole. A classic chalice shape with a distended apical mucin vacuole is not clearly demonstrated at this resolution. Findings are compatible with, but not diagnostic of, goblet cells of respiratory mucosa.

ddx.vs: Ciliated cells are columnar with a terminal plate and apical cilia rather than a mucin-distended foamy cytoplasm.
Squamous cells are larger and flat with abundant homogeneous angular cytoplasm and a small central nucleus, without foamy mucin.
Macrophages have a bean-shaped or folded nucleus and vacuoles containing phagocytosed debris rather than a single basal round nucleus under a mucin cup.

64481.recognize_zh: 分葉核中性球的細胞質邊緣可見一個淡藍灰色、邊界模糊的橢圓形包涵體（紅箭頭），同時伴有毒性顆粒與空泡，符合 Döhle 小體。
features: Segmented neutrophil (~14 µm) with a pale blue-grey, poorly demarcated oval cytoplasmic inclusion near the cell membrane (red arrow)
Coarse, dark toxic granulation throughout the cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic vacuolation
Normal nuclear segmentation (3 lobes) with condensed chromatin
Background red cells without obvious giant platelets in this field
64481.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a small, pale blue-grey, oval cytoplasmic inclusion at the periphery of the cell, consistent with a Döhle body. The same cell shows coarse toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuoles. No giant platelets are present in this field. Findings are consistent with toxic (reactive) neutrophil changes, as seen in sepsis, burns, or severe inflammation.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more spindle-shaped and sharply defined, occur without toxic granulation or vacuoles, and are accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Morulae are dark blue-purple, stippled mulberry-like clusters rather than a pale homogeneous blue-grey smudge.
Chediak-Higashi granules are giant, discrete, azurophilic/grey granules rather than a pale, ill-defined ribosomal patch.
Engulfed organisms are sharply outlined cocci, rods or yeasts, often within vacuoles, and are more darkly stained.

64417.recognize_zh: 抹片上散布大小不一、深紫色、呈分枝狀或雪花狀的結晶樣碎片，形態不像任何血球；同時分析儀散佈圖（WDF、WNR）在低訊號區出現未分類的異常族群（紅色箭頭），代表檢體受外來物質（EMLA 麻醉乳膏）污染造成的干擾。
features: Panel A: WDF and WNR scattergrams with an abnormal unidentified low-fluorescence population (red arrows) merging with debris/ghost region
Deep purple, crystal-like extracellular fragments of variable size with branching, fern- or snowflake-like outlines (panel B)
Fragments lie between red cells and are not attached to cell membranes; no nucleus or granular platelet structure
Background red cells, a neutrophil and a lymphocyte appear morphologically normal
No true platelet clumps or microorganisms evident
64417.describe_en: The Sysmex WDF and WNR scattergrams show an abnormal, unclassified population in the low-fluorescence region (arrows) that falsely increased the raw WBC count. The corresponding May-Grünwald-Giemsa-stained blood smear shows numerous extracellular, deep purple, crystal-like fragments of variable size with branching, fern-like contours, lying free between otherwise normal red cells and leukocytes. These structures do not resemble platelet clumps, cryoglobulin, bacteria or fungi. Findings are consistent with an exogenous pre-analytical interference, here attributed to contamination of the sample by residual EMLA topical anesthetic emulsion.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps are pale-blue aggregates of individual granular platelets, often at the feathered edge, rather than homogeneous dark branching crystals.
Cryoglobulins form pale blue-grey amorphous or crystalline extracellular deposits that disappear when the sample is warmed to 37 °C.
Stain precipitate is fine, granular and scattered over cells and background in a single plane, lacks the discrete branching crystal forms, and disappears with filtered stain.
Microorganisms show regular septate hyphae, yeast budding or uniform cocci/rods, often phagocytosed by neutrophils, unlike these irregular crystalline fragments.

64353.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的細胞比周圍紅血球大約兩倍，核分成多個圓形分葉並排成一圈（葡萄串狀，botryoid），細胞質淡粉紅、顆粒少，這是巨大過度分葉的嗜中性球。
features: Enlarged neutrophil, roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Nucleus divided into multiple (about 6) rounded lobes arranged radially in a cluster (botryoid pattern)
Coarsely clumped chromatin within each lobe; no nucleoli
Pale, lightly granular cytoplasm without obvious toxic granulation at this resolution
Background of bone marrow aspirate with red cells and scattered small lymphoid/erythroid cells
64353.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered hematopoietic cells in a red-cell-rich background. The arrowed cell is a large neutrophil with a nucleus composed of multiple rounded lobes clustered in a grape-like (botryoid) arrangement and pale, sparsely granular cytoplasm. Nuclear lobes remain connected and chromatin is mature; no blasts are present in this field. Findings are consistent with a botryoid (giant hypersegmented) neutrophil, a reactive change reported with hyperthermia and severe infection such as scrub typhus.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils show linear chains of 6 or more lobes with accompanying macro-ovalocytes and megaloblastic erythroid precursors, rather than rounded lobes clustered radially around a center.

ddx.dx: Tetraploid/giant neutrophil in myelodysplasia or post-chemotherapy
ddx.vs: Dysplastic giant neutrophils occur with other dysplastic features (hypogranularity, pseudo-Pelger cells) and a clinical myeloid neoplasm or cytotoxic exposure, whereas botryoid change is transient and tied to fever or heat stroke.
Apoptotic cells have small dense, smooth, pyknotic nuclear fragments with a shrunken hypereosinophilic cytoplasm, not enlarged cells with multiple chromatin-textured lobes.

64161.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中大量紅血球表面有少數不規則、長短不一的尖刺（棘狀紅血球 acanthocytes），夾雜刺較規則短小的皺縮細胞（echinocytes）與少數小而緻密的球形紅血球，無明顯裂片細胞；本例歸因於 alectinib 藥物。
features: Numerous acanthocytes: dense red cells lacking central pallor with a few irregularly spaced projections of variable length
Admixed echinocytes with more numerous, short, evenly spaced spicules
Occasional small dense spherocytes and spheroacanthocytes
Remaining red cells normocytic with central pallor; no significant schistocytes
Platelets present in normal numbers without clumping; scale bar label (500 um) is implausible for this magnification
64161.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a normocytic red cell population with numerous acanthocytes bearing few, irregularly distributed spicules of variable length, admixed with echinocytes and occasional small dense spherocytes and spheroacanthocytes. Schistocytes are not increased, and platelets appear adequate. The spicules are not artifactually distributed only in thick or thin areas of the film. In a patient treated with the ALK inhibitor alectinib, findings are consistent with drug-induced acanthocytosis/spheroacanthocytosis, which is typically associated with subclinical hemolysis. The embedded scale bar label appears incorrect for this magnification.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes (burr cells) from drying artifact or uremia
ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, uniform projections and retain central pallor, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules of varying length on a dense cell.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of advanced liver disease
ddx.vs: Spur cell anemia shows similar acanthocytes but occurs with severe cirrhosis and target cells, often with brisk hemolysis, and lacks an alectinib history.
Inherited acanthocytosis presents with neurologic disease or fat malabsorption with low lipoproteins, rather than acquired onset after starting alectinib that reverses on switching drugs.
HS shows spherocytes without prominent spiculated forms and a lifelong history, whereas alectinib-induced EMA binding reduction is acquired and reversible.

64097.recognize_zh: 右上方一群大型細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質豐富淡藍且邊界不清、彼此融合，並有散在深色顆粒，與周圍較小的顆粒球系細胞截然不同，符合非造血的轉移性癌細胞團；但單一視野下難與組織球或造骨細胞完全區分。
features: Loose aggregate of large cells (upper right) with round-to-oval nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct, syncytial borders
Scattered dark coarse granules/debris over the cytoplasm of the aggregate
Large single cell (lower center) with a round nucleus and abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Admixed smaller hematopoietic cells: myelocytes/band forms, a small lymphocyte and a nucleated red cell
Hemodilute background with lysed red cells and a large clear fat space; no tight three-dimensional cohesion in this field
64097.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with scattered myeloid and erythroid precursors. There is a loose aggregate of large cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct syncytial borders, as well as a large cell with abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm; these cells are several times the size of adjacent granulocytes. Cohesion is less pronounced in this field than in classic tumor clusters, and distinction from macrophages or osteoblasts is limited on a single field. In the context of known gastric carcinoma, findings are suggestive of metastatic carcinoma, which should be confirmed on the trephine biopsy with cytokeratin immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Macrophages occur singly with kidney-shaped nuclei and phagocytosed debris or hemosiderin, and do not form syncytial groups of nuclei with high N:C variation; CD68/CD163 versus cytokeratin resolves it.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale perinuclear hof set away from the nucleus and form comet-like rows, and are keratin-negative.
Megakaryocytes are single cells with one large lobulated nucleus and pink granular cytoplasm, not several separate round nuclei in shared blue cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Hematolymphoid neoplasm (e.g., ALCL or large cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are dyscohesive with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and express CD45 or lineage markers rather than cytokeratin.

64033.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆胞質深藍的大型紅血球前驅細胞，染色體呈帶狀排列（有絲分裂中期），周圍有數個核深染、輪廓呈不規則分葉或出芽狀的紅血球母細胞，提示紅血球系發育不良（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Large basophilic erythroblast with deeply blue cytoplasm and condensed chromosomes aligned in a band, consistent with a cell in metaphase
Several erythroid precursors with dense, irregular, lobulated or budding nuclear contours and small clear vacuole-like spaces, suggestive of nuclear budding/karyorrhexis
Polychromatic erythroblasts with round nuclei, coarse chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm
Occasional orthochromatic erythroblast with pyknotic nucleus
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
64033.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Giemsa stain, high power) shows erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation. A large basophilic erythroblast is in metaphase, and several erythroblasts have dense, irregularly lobulated or budding nuclear outlines, suggestive of nuclear budding and karyorrhexis. Polychromatic and orthochromatic erythroblasts with coarse chromatin are also present. Findings are suggestive of dyserythropoiesis; in the context of myelodysplastic syndrome, at least 10% dysplastic erythroid cells should be documented across the smear, along with iron stain and cytogenetic correlation.

ddx.vs: B12/folate deficiency causes nuclear irregularity with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony plus giant metamyelocytes, and resolves with replacement.
CDA presents in young patients with isolated erythroid dysplasia (binucleation, internuclear bridging) and no clonal or other-lineage abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Reactive erythroid changes (drugs, alcohol, HIV, heavy metals)
ddx.vs: Non-clonal dyserythropoiesis lacks cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities and reverses after removing the cause.
Mitotic figures are normal in erythroid hyperplasia, so dysplasia must rest on irregular nuclear budding, multinucleation or megaloblastoid change rather than mitoses alone.

63969.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有成巢、成腺泡狀排列的大型外來上皮細胞，細胞質豐富淡染微泡狀、核圓形空泡狀並有明顯核仁，與旁邊小而深染的紅系及顆粒球前驅細胞截然不同，符合轉移性攝護腺腺癌。
features: Nests and vague acinar/glandular clusters of large cohesive epithelial cells foreign to marrow
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with prominent single nucleoli and relatively uniform size
Abundant pale, finely vacuolated to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Adjacent residual trilineage hematopoiesis: erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei, eosinophilic myelocytes and neutrophils
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and fat spaces in the background
63969.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy section shows infiltration by nests and small gland-like clusters of large, cohesive epithelial cells that are foreign to the marrow. The tumor cells have round vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, contrasting with adjacent residual hematopoiesis that includes erythroid precursors, eosinophilic myelocytes and neutrophils. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma, and in this clinical setting with metastatic prostatic adenocarcinoma, confirmable by NKX3.1, PSA or PSMA immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single cells with lobulated hyperchromatic nuclei and osteoblasts line bone with eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof, unlike cohesive nests with prominent nucleoli that are keratin positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic adenocarcinoma from another primary (e.g. lung, breast, GI)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so an immunopanel (NKX3.1/PSA for prostate versus TTF-1, GATA3 or CDX2) is needed to assign the primary.

ddx.dx: Histiocytic aggregates (e.g. Gaucher or storage cells)
ddx.vs: Histiocytes have small eccentric nuclei without prominent nucleoli and are CD68/CD163 positive and keratin negative.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology
ddx.vs: Plasmablasts are discohesive with eccentric nuclei and are CD138/MUM1 positive with light chain restriction rather than forming glands.

63905.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的骨髓顆粒球前驅細胞，細胞質內有明顯比正常顆粒大很多的巨大包涵顆粒（上方細胞為粉紅至紅色大顆粒、左下帶狀核細胞為深色桿狀包涵體），符合 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的巨大溶酶體顆粒。
features: Myeloid precursors containing giant, round cytoplasmic granules much larger than normal primary/secondary granules
Top cell (promyelocyte/myelocyte): several discrete pink-red giant granules clustered at one side of the cytoplasm
Middle cell (myelocyte): coarse grayish inclusion within granular cytoplasm
Lower-left band/metamyelocyte: dark elongated inclusion in pale cytoplasm
Otherwise normal-appearing nuclear maturation; background red cells and platelets
63905.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors with normal nuclear maturation. Several precursors contain abnormally large, discrete cytoplasmic granules and inclusions, including clusters of pink-red giant granules in a promyelocyte/myelocyte and an elongated dark inclusion in a band form. The inclusions are markedly larger than normal azurophilic or specific granules. No blasts are increased in this field. Findings are consistent with giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, but pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules occur in a clonal myeloid neoplasm with increased blasts/dysplasia and the patient lacks oculocutaneous albinism or LYST mutation.
Alder-Reilly granules are diffuse, dark, fine-to-coarse granules filling the cytoplasm of all granulocytes and lymphocytes, not a few discrete giant granules.
Toxic granules are small, evenly distributed dark granules in neutrophils, not large single inclusions.
These are pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic RNA inclusions (with giant platelets in MYH9 disorders), not pink-red lysosomal granules.

63841.recognize_zh: 三張小腿臨床照片：A 為散在、中央壞死結痂的潰瘍性丘疹／結節與周圍紅斑；B 為大片融合的黑色壞死痂與滲出潰瘍；C 治療後潰瘍癒合，只留色素沉著與萎縮疤痕。快速進展的壞死潰瘍病灶要想到侵襲性表皮向性 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞淋巴瘤，但確診需靠切片與免疫染色。
features: Clinical photographs of the lower leg in three time points (A, B, C)
A: multiple scattered ulcerated papulonodules with central black necrotic crusts on erythematous, purpuric background
B: extensive confluent necrotic eschar with exudative ulceration, crusting and surrounding scale
C: healed skin with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, atrophic scars and residual pink macules
No histologic information available in the image
63841.describe_en: Clinical photographs of the lower leg document disease evolution. Panel A shows multiple scattered erythematous papulonodules with central ulceration and black necrotic crusts; panel B shows progression to a large confluent necrotic, exudative ulcer with eschar; panel C shows healing after chemotherapy with hyperpigmentation and atrophic scarring. These appearances indicate a rapidly progressive ulceronecrotic cutaneous process but are not specific. Diagnosis of primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma requires biopsy demonstrating pagetoid epidermotropic atypical CD8+ cytotoxic T cells.

ddx.vs: It also forms necrotic ulcerated plaques but the atypical cells are TCR-gamma/delta positive and usually CD8-negative, often with panniculitic involvement.
It shows angiocentric necrosis with CD56+ cells that are EBER-positive, whereas the aggressive CD8+ epidermotropic lymphoma is EBV-negative and here CD56-negative.

ddx.dx: Lymphomatoid papulosis type D or CD30+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: LyP type D mimics CD8+ epidermotropism but is strongly CD30+ with self-healing papules, whereas this case is CD30-negative and progressive.
These show neutrophil-rich or microbial ulcers without an atypical clonal-appearing CD8+ epidermotropic T-cell infiltrate on biopsy.

63713.recognize_zh: 大量小而圓、深染且缺乏中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes），中央有一顆有核紅血球（nucleated RBC），另可見少數偏大、偏藍灰的多染性紅血球（polychromasia），符合遺傳性球形紅血球症溶血恢復期的表現。
features: Numerous spherocytes: small, round, densely stained red cells lacking central pallor
Mixed population with normal discocytes showing central pallor
Single nucleated red cell with condensed round nucleus and small rim of cytoplasm
Scattered larger bluish-gray polychromatophilic red cells
Adequate platelets; partial neutrophil at lower right edge
63713.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous spherocytes, which are small, round and hyperchromatic without central pallor, admixed with normal discocytes. Scattered larger polychromatophilic red cells are present, and a single nucleated red blood cell is seen in the center of the field, indicating an active marrow erythroid response. Red cell fragments and agglutinates are not prominent, and platelets appear adequate. In the appropriate clinical context (recovery from parvovirus B19 infection), findings are consistent with hereditary spherocytosis.

ddx.vs: Warm AIHA can show identical spherocytes with polychromasia, so a positive direct antiglobulin test (versus negative in HS) and family history/EMA binding are required to separate them.

ddx.dx: ABO hemolytic disease of the newborn
ddx.vs: Neonatal ABO incompatibility produces microspherocytes with a positive DAT in an infant of an O mother, rather than a chronic familial pattern.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet cells, triangular fragments) and thrombocytopenia rather than a predominance of round intact spherocytes.
HPP has microspherocytes plus bizarre budding fragments and elliptocytes with a very low MCV, which are not present here.

63649.recognize_zh: 四張未標示的低倍影像：上排推測為 kappa 與 lambda 原位雜交（ISH），只有右側大量細胞著色，表示 lambda 輕鏈限制；下排為 Congo red 染色見淡紅色無細胞沉積物，偏光下沉積物出現雙折射，支持類澱粉（amyloid）。
features: Four-panel low-power composite of a lymph node core biopsy; panels unlabeled
Top left: pale, lightly stained core with few or no positive cells (interpreted as kappa ISH)
Top right: many cells with dark purple chromogenic signal (interpreted as lambda ISH), indicating lambda restriction
Bottom left: Congo red stain showing salmon-pink amorphous acellular deposits with cracking artifact
Bottom right: same area under polarized light with birefringent streaks; apple-green hue not clearly resolved at this resolution
63649.describe_en: Four-panel low-power composite of a lymph node core biopsy with unlabeled panels. The upper panels are interpreted as kappa and lambda in situ hybridization, with scant staining in the left panel and abundant positive plasma cells in the right, indicating lambda light chain restriction. The lower panels show Congo red staining of extensive salmon-pink amorphous deposits with cracking artifact and, under polarized light, birefringence of the deposits, although the characteristic apple-green color is not clearly resolved at this magnification and image quality. Findings support a lambda-restricted plasma cell neoplasm with AL amyloid deposition; confirmation of apple-green birefringence on the glass slide and amyloid typing by mass spectrometry are recommended.

ddx.vs: Collagen may be pink on Congo red but shows white/silvery rather than apple-green birefringence.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative and non-fibrillar granular by electron microscopy.
Reactive plasma cells are positive for both kappa and lambda ISH in roughly a 2:1 ratio.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic or marginal zone lymphoma with amyloid
ddx.vs: These contain a CD20-positive clonal B-cell component sharing the same light chain.

63649.stain: ISH: kappa/lambda; Congo red with polarization

63585.recognize_zh: 一群聚集的大細胞，核為單一、偏心的橢圓形，胞質豐富呈藍紫色、邊緣模糊如彗星狀，且淡染的高基氏區（Golgi zone）與細胞核有距離，這是骨髓抽吸常見的成骨細胞（osteoblasts），不要誤認成漿細胞或轉移癌。
features: Loose cluster of large cells, larger than plasma cells, with ill-defined wispy cytoplasmic borders
Single eccentric oval nucleus often appearing to be extruded toward the cell edge
Fine to lightly stippled chromatin with small indistinct nucleoli
Abundant basophilic, finely granular cytoplasm with a pale Golgi zone set away from the nucleus
Background of red cell aggregates with rouleaux-like stacking and scattered platelets
63585.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a loose cluster of large cells with single eccentric oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders. A pale perinuclear-to-central clear zone (Golgi area) is separated from the nucleus in some cells. Nuclear atypia and mitoses are not seen. Findings are consistent with normal osteoblasts, commonly encountered in aspirates from children or areas of active bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin and a hof immediately adjacent to the nucleus, whereas the osteoblast Golgi zone lies away from the nucleus.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism, high N:C ratio, prominent nucleoli and molding, unlike the bland, comet-shaped osteoblasts.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated giant cells, while osteoblasts are mononuclear.

63521.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆小至中型淋巴球，染色質緻密、細胞質稀少淡藍，細胞核被一道深凹裂分成兩葉，無中性球顆粒，可認出雙葉淋巴球（bilobed lymphocyte）。
features: Single small-to-medium lymphocyte, slightly larger than a red cell
High N:C ratio with a scant rim of pale blue, agranular cytoplasm
Nucleus divided by a deep cleft into two closely apposed lobes
Mature, condensed clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Background of normochromic normocytic red cells and scattered normal platelets
63521.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic normochromic red cells and adequate platelets. A single small-to-medium lymphocyte is present with a high N:C ratio, scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm, and a nucleus split by a deep cleft into two lobes with mature condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. No blasts or cytoplasmic granulation are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a bilobed lymphocyte, a morphologic variant that should prompt correlation with the overall lymphocyte count and clinical context.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells show multilobated, petal-like nuclei with more than two lobes and are usually numerous, whereas this is an isolated cell with a simple two-lobed nucleus.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclear convolutions rather than a single deep cleft producing two smooth lobes.
Granulocytes have abundant granular cytoplasm (neutral or orange-red granules), whereas this cell has only a scant agranular rim of cytoplasm.
Follicular lymphoma cells are small cleaved cells with a narrow notch and are usually accompanied by lymphocytosis; flow cytometry for CD10+ clonal B cells separates them.

63329.recognize_zh: 兩個成熟淋巴球並排，核染色質緻密呈塊狀，左側細胞胞質內有同心弧狀排列的細絲狀包涵體，右側細胞胞質也有淡淡的線狀結構；在 CLL 抹片上這是細絲狀胞質包涵體。
features: Two mature lymphocytes with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; nuclei slightly indented
Moderate pale cytoplasm
Left cell: concentric, arc-like filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions
Right cell: fainter linear cytoplasmic filaments
Background crenated red cells and several platelets
63329.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin, slightly indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm. The left cell contains concentric arc-like filamentous cytoplasmic inclusions, and the right cell shows fainter linear filaments. Red cells are crenated, and platelets are present. In the setting of CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells with filamentous intracytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have villous projections along the cell membrane and bland oval nuclei, confirmed by CD103/CD25/annexin A1 positivity.
Villous lymphocytes show polar short projections rather than internal filaments and are CD5-negative.
Plasmacytoid cells have basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and globular inclusions, typically in LPL.

63265.recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的流式細胞雙參數圖：紅色族群集中在左上象限（Q1），即 TCRγδ 陽性、TCRαβ 陰性，形成一團緊密的單一族群，綠色的背景正常 T 細胞則為 TCRαβ 陽性；γδ T 細胞異常擴增支持 γδ 型 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on lymphocytes: TCR gamma/delta PE (y-axis) vs TCR alpha/beta FITC (x-axis)
Dominant, tight red population in Q1: TCR gamma/delta positive, TCR alpha/beta negative
Green background T cells in Q3/Q4: TCR gamma/delta negative with dim to moderate TCR alpha/beta
Small light-blue population near the origin, negative for both TCRs (likely B and NK cells)
Clustered, homogeneous expression pattern of the gamma/delta population suggests clonal expansion
63265.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays TCR gamma/delta (y-axis) versus TCR alpha/beta (x-axis). The predominant population (red) is TCR gamma/delta-positive and TCR alpha/beta-negative, forming a compact, homogeneous cluster in the upper left quadrant, while a smaller residual population of background T cells (green) expresses TCR alpha/beta without TCR gamma/delta. A minor double-negative population (blue) likely represents non-T lymphocytes. An expanded, phenotypically uniform gamma/delta T-cell population in the appropriate clinical and morphologic setting is consistent with gamma/delta T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia; clonality should be confirmed by TCR gene rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive expansions (e.g., infection, post-transplant) are polyclonal on TCR gene rearrangement or V-delta/V-gamma repertoire analysis and are usually transient, whereas T-LGL leukemia is clonal and persistent.

Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma is also usually gamma/delta but presents with hepatosplenomegaly, sinusoidal marrow infiltration, CD56 positivity, isochromosome 7q and aggressive course rather than indolent cytopenias with LGL morphology.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous or mucosal gamma/delta T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are aggressive extranodal tumors with tissue masses and cytotoxic phenotype, not a circulating indolent LGL population.
The more common alpha/beta type would place the clonal CD8+ population in the TCR alpha/beta-positive quadrant, not the TCR gamma/delta quadrant.

63201.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆小型成熟淋巴球，核深染、胞質很窄，但藍色胞質內有數個清楚的圓形小空泡（vacuole）；在溶小體貯積症（如 Niemann-Pick）的背景下，空泡化淋巴球是重要線索。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with round nucleus, condensed chromatin and high N:C ratio
Narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing several small, sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
No cytoplasmic granules or nuclear atypia
Background red cells mostly normocytic with a few paler irregular cells; scattered platelets
63201.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte with a round nucleus, condensed chromatin and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing multiple small, discrete, sharply defined clear vacuoles. No granules or nuclear atypia are present. Background red cells are mostly unremarkable with a few paler cells, and scattered platelets are seen. Vacuolated lymphocytes are nonspecific in isolation but, in the appropriate context (hepatosplenomegaly, foamy marrow macrophages), are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Storage-related vacuolation affects many cell types, especially neutrophils and monocytes, in aged samples, whereas storage-disease vacuoles appear in fresh smears and in a consistent proportion of lymphocytes.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, finely clumped chromatin and nucleoli, not small mature lymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Other storage disorders (Pompe, Wolman, mucopolysaccharidoses, neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis)
ddx.vs: Vacuolated lymphocytes are shared, so enzyme assays or genetic testing, plus clues such as Alder-Reilly granules in mucopolysaccharidoses, are needed to separate them.

63137.recognize_zh: S-100 染色中，大型組織球的細胞核與細胞質呈強陽性，箭頭處細胞內可見多個未染色的淋巴球輪廓（被吞入的細胞呈負影），清楚凸顯 emperipolesis，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的關鍵免疫染色。
features: IHC for S100 at high power
Large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 staining
Negative-image intracytoplasmic lymphocytes within a large positive histiocyte (emperipolesis, arrow)
Engulfed cells retain intact round nuclei with surrounding halos
Diffuse staining of neighboring histiocytes creates a dense brown background
63137.describe_en: S100 immunostain at high power shows large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity. A large S100-positive histiocyte contains multiple intact, unstained lymphocytes within its cytoplasm, highlighted as negative images (emperipolesis, arrow). Neighboring histiocytes are also strongly positive. Findings confirm the Rosai-Dorfman histiocyte phenotype (S100+, typically CD68+/CD163+, CD1a−) and are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: LCH is also S100 positive but shows grooved nuclei and CD1a/langerin positivity without emperipolesis.
Melanoma is S100 positive but shows cytologic atypia, nucleoli, and SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A positivity, and lacks emperipolesis.
IDCS is S100 positive but forms a spindled-to-ovoid fascicular or whorled neoplasm with atypia, lacking emperipolesis and the plasma cell-rich background.
HLH macrophages are S100 negative and degrade the engulfed cells.

62945.recognize_zh: CD20 染色只在散在的大型非典型細胞呈強棕色膜陽性，這些細胞核大、形狀不規則，周圍大量小淋巴球與組織球為陰性，幾乎沒有小 B 細胞；少數大型 B 細胞散布於非 B 細胞背景，是 T 細胞/組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的典型免疫型態。
features: Scattered large atypical cells with strong membranous CD20 staining
Positive cells have large oval to irregular vesicular nuclei, some multilobated
Large B cells are dispersed singly or in loose groups, not in sheets
Paucity of CD20-positive small B cells in the background
Numerous CD20-negative small lymphocytes and histiocytes with oval to elongated nuclei
62945.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of scattered, singly dispersed large atypical cells with large irregular vesicular nuclei. The background small lymphocytes and histiocytes are negative, with a notable paucity of small B cells. These large B cells comprise a minority of the infiltrate within a T-cell- and histiocyte-rich background. Findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL LP cells are CD20+ but lie in nodules rich in small CD20+ B cells with CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD20-negative or weak and heterogeneous, with CD30/CD15 positivity.
DLBCL NOS shows sheets of CD20+ large cells rather than scattered large B cells comprising a small minority.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with bystander B blasts
ddx.vs: Bystander B blasts are often EBER+ and accompany atypical clonal T cells with aberrant phenotype.

62881.recognize_zh: 低倍下息肉狀的大腸黏膜片段，固有層被密集的淋巴浸潤瀰漫撐開，腺窩被均勻隔開但形態大致保存、表面上皮完整，呈現非破壞性的黏膜淋巴浸潤。
features: Polypoid colonic mucosal fragment at low power
Dense, diffuse lamina propria infiltrate spacing crypts widely apart
Crypts rounded and preserved with intact goblet cells; surface epithelium intact
No ulceration, necrosis or lymphoid follicles evident
Adjacent fragments with similar dense infiltrate
62881.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows a polypoid fragment of colonic mucosa in which the lamina propria is diffusely expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate, spacing the crypts apart. The crypts and surface epithelium are preserved, and there is no ulceration, necrosis or follicular architecture. This non-destructive, diffuse mucosal lymphoid expansion correlates with the polypoid endoscopic lesions and is consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract in this case.

ddx.vs: Benign lymphoid polyps show well-formed reactive germinal centers and a polyclonal mixed B/T infiltrate.
MCL forms similar polyps but the infiltrate is CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1-positive.
MALT lymphoma shows lymphoepithelial lesions and B-cell (CD20) positivity.

62817.recognize_zh: 骨髓觸摸抹片（touch prep）油鏡下，數顆中到大型細胞核偏位、胞質豐富淡藍，看似漿細胞（plasmacytoid）；但核較大、染色質細顆粒狀而非車輪狀、缺乏明顯核周亮區，細胞彼此鬆散相鄰，要想到外觀像漿細胞的轉移性癌（如乳小葉癌），需免疫染色區分。
features: Oil-immersion touch preparation with a loose group of about six medium-to-large plasmacytoid cells
Eccentric round-to-oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin, lacking coarse clock-face clumping
Moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm without a distinct perinuclear hof
One cell with a clear retraction halo/possible cytoplasmic vacuole around the nucleus
Cells lie singly or loosely apposed without tight cohesive clusters
Background with amorphous brown extracellular material and a few small dark nucleated cells
62817.describe_en: Touch preparation of the bone marrow core examined under oil immersion shows medium-to-large cells with eccentrically placed round-to-oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm, imparting a plasmacytoid appearance. The cells lack the coarse clock-face chromatin and prominent perinuclear hof of mature plasma cells and are larger than the adjacent small nucleated cells. Amorphous brown extracellular material is present in the background. Morphology alone cannot separate a plasma cell neoplasm from a plasmacytoid non-hematopoietic tumor, and immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, CD138, kappa/lambda, GATA3) is required; in this case the cells represented metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells usually retain clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof and are kappa or lambda restricted, whereas these carcinoma cells are light chain negative and keratin/GATA3 positive.
Favored when plasmacytoid cells lack light chains and show intracytoplasmic mucin vacuoles with cytoplasmic p120 and E-cadherin loss.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger with prominent central nucleoli, high mitotic rate and often EBER positivity, and remain keratin negative.
Melanoma can be plasmacytoid but is SOX10, S100 and Melan-A positive, often with intranuclear pseudoinclusions or pigment.

62753.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大型母細胞染色質細緻、胞質內有明顯的嗜天青顆粒，外觀像骨髓性母細胞；但流式顯示 CD19+CD10+、cCD79a+CD34+、TdT+ 而 MPO 陰性，證實是帶顆粒的 B 前驅細胞急性淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin, and indistinct nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing prominent coarse azurophilic granules
No Auer rods identified
Flow: CD45-dim/low side-scatter blasts that are CD19+ CD10+, cytoplasmic CD79a+ CD34+, and TdT-positive
Flow: cytoplasmic MPO negative
62753.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows large blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing conspicuous coarse azurophilic granules, without Auer rods. Occasional mature leukocytes are present in the background. Flow cytometry of the CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast gate demonstrates expression of CD19, CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a, CD34, and TdT, with no cytoplasmic MPO. Despite the granular cytoplasm, the immunophenotype establishes B-lineage; findings are consistent with granular B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain azurophilic granules and Auer rods but are MPO-positive and lack the CD19/CD10/cCD79a/TdT B-lineage profile.
MPAL requires MPO or monocytic differentiation markers in addition to B-lineage markers, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative.
t(8;21) AML shows granular blasts with CD19 and sometimes TdT but is MPO-positive with Auer rods and salmon-colored granules, and lacks CD10.
Hematogones are small cells with scant agranular cytoplasm and show a maturing, continuous CD10/CD20/CD34 pattern rather than a monomorphic expanded blast population.

62625.recognize_zh: HHV8 染色較高倍下，散在的大型細胞核呈棕色、帶有斑點狀（顆粒狀）的核內著色，細胞質不著色，這種點狀 LANA 核型態是 HHV8 感染的特徵。
features: Scattered cells with nuclear HHV8 (LANA-1) staining in loose stroma
Characteristic speckled/stippled granular nuclear pattern in many positive cells
Positive nuclei are enlarged and round to oval; cytoplasm unstained
Negative stromal and inflammatory nuclei with blue counterstain
Edematous stroma with irregular clear spaces
62625.describe_en: HHV8 (LANA-1) immunohistochemistry shows numerous scattered enlarged cells with nuclear staining, many displaying the characteristic speckled or granular nuclear pattern, while stromal and small inflammatory cells are negative. Stippled nuclear LANA staining is specific for HHV8 latent infection. In a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, immunoglobulin-negative large-cell lymphoma, this finding is consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma shows the same LANA pattern in spindle cells lining vascular slits that are CD31/ERG-positive rather than CD45/MUM1-positive lymphoid cells.
In MCD, LANA-positive plasmablasts are few and confined to follicle mantle zones, not diffusely infiltrating stroma.
Morphology and phenotype overlap, but plasmablastic lymphoma is LANA-negative.

62561.recognize_zh: 抹片中有一顆遠大於周圍細胞的大型細胞，具兩個相對的腎形核、細緻染色質與灰藍色豐富胞質，旁邊只有一個小細胞核作比例；這種巨大多核／腎形核的淋巴瘤細胞是 ALCL 標誌細胞在抹片上的樣貌。
features: Single very large cell, many times the size of the adjacent small nucleus
Two large reniform/lobated nuclei facing each other, with finely granular chromatin and a paranuclear clear zone
Abundant grayish-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders and a few small vacuoles
Background with platelet clumps and stripped debris; no granules in the large cell
62561.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained aspirate smear shows a single very large atypical cell with abundant gray-blue, slightly vacuolated cytoplasm and two large reniform nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, arranged around a paranuclear clear zone. The cell is many times the size of an adjacent small bare nucleus. The background contains platelet clumps and debris without other hematopoietic elements in this field. The morphology is that of a large anaplastic lymphoid cell and, in the context of a known ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma, is suggestive of marrow involvement; confirmation by CD30/ALK immunostaining or flow cytometry is required.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus with coarse chromatin and granular pink cytoplasm, not two separate reniform nuclei with agranular blue cytoplasm.
RS cells have prominent inclusion-like macronucleoli, whereas this cell shows fine chromatin without large nucleoli, and ALCL is CD30/ALK-positive.
Osteoclasts have multiple uniform separate nuclei and granular cytoplasm, and carcinoma cells tend to cluster and are keratin-positive.

62497.recognize_zh: 抹片中滿是小而圓、染色質粗塊狀的成熟小淋巴球，夾雜數個被壓扁的破碎細胞（smudge cells），箭頭指向一顆較大、有核仁的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte），右下為殘存巨核細胞，是 CLL 骨髓抹片典型表現。
features: Predominance of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei and coarse, block-like clumped chromatin
Scant rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm; nucleoli absent in most cells
Scattered smudge/crushed cells with streaked nuclear material
Occasional larger prolymphocyte with a visible nucleolus (arrow)
Residual megakaryocyte present; other hematopoietic elements markedly reduced
62497.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small, mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Smudge cells are scattered throughout, and an occasional larger prolymphocyte with a distinct nucleolus is present (arrow), without a significant prolymphocyte population in this field. A residual megakaryocyte is seen, while granulocytic and erythroid precursors are sparse. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often more pleomorphic with irregular or notched nuclei and are cyclin D1 positive, CD23 negative.
B-PLL is dominated by medium-sized cells with prominent central nucleoli, whereas here prolymphocytes are rare.
SMZL cells have more abundant cytoplasm, sometimes with polar villous projections, and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.

62433.recognize_zh: 低倍下左上角可見小腸絨毛黏膜，其下方腸壁被一大片均一、瀰漫性的淋巴樣細胞取代並伴有出血；這是腸道（非淋巴結）的瀰漫性淋巴瘤浸潤，典型的 starry-sky 淡色巨噬細胞斑點在此倍率下僅隱約可見，需高倍確認。
features: Small intestinal mucosa with villi and crypts at the upper left edge
Underlying bowel wall replaced by a diffuse, sheet-like, monotonous lymphoid infiltrate
Loss of normal submucosal and mural architecture without nodularity
Foci of hemorrhage at the mucosa-tumor interface
Starry-sky mottling from tingible-body macrophages is only faintly discernible at this low magnification
62433.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows small intestinal mucosa with villi at the upper left, beneath which the bowel wall is effaced by a diffuse, monotonous, sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate with scattered foci of hemorrhage. No nodular or follicular architecture is present. At this magnification the characteristic starry-sky pattern of interspersed tingible-body macrophages is only faintly appreciable, and cytologic features cannot be assessed; the tissue is intestine rather than lymph node as the title states. In the ileocecal region of a young patient, this diffuse transmural lymphoid infiltrate is suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma, pending high-power cytology, Ki-67, CD10/BCL2 and MYC studies.

ddx.vs: DLBCL is composed of larger pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei, variable BCL2 expression and Ki-67 usually below near-100%.
Mantle cell lymphoma forms multiple nodules of small cyclin D1-positive cells without a starry-sky pattern.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma can show starry-sky change but is TdT-positive with fine blastic chromatin.
Myeloid sarcoma contains eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO/CD117-positive rather than CD20/CD10-positive.

62369.recognize_zh: CD5 染色中擴張的外套層細胞呈大片、強而一致的膜狀陽性，而生發中心內只有散在陽性 T 細胞；因 CD3 在外套層是陰性，表示這些 CD5 陽性細胞是異常 B 細胞。
features: Dense, uniform membranous CD5 staining of the expanded mantle zone population
Pale germinal centers containing only scattered CD5-positive T cells
Interfollicular areas with loosely scattered positive cells
Staining intensity in mantle zones comparable to T cells, in a sheet-like distribution
62369.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows strong membranous staining of the monotonous lymphoid population filling the expanded mantle zones, while germinal centers contain only scattered CD5-positive T cells. Because the mantle zone cells are CD3-negative and CD20-positive on companion stains, the CD5 expression represents aberrant co-expression on B cells. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern, to be confirmed with cyclin D1 or SOX11.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is CD5+ but CD23+ LEF1+ with proliferation centers and a diffuse pattern, and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Reactive CD5+ cells are T cells that co-express CD3 and are located in the paracortex rather than filling mantle zones.
Rare MZL is CD5+ but lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11 and shows marginal zone/monocytoid expansion outside the mantle.

62305.recognize_zh: 三個漿細胞核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face），細胞質淡藍並含細長針狀結晶（類 Auer 小體），背景也散佈游離的棒狀結晶，提示漿細胞骨髓瘤伴結晶性包涵體。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin
Moderate blue-gray cytoplasm with pale perinuclear zones
Slender needle-like, rod-shaped crystalline inclusions within the cytoplasm
Numerous free rod-like crystals scattered in the background
Background red cells without rouleaux in this thin area
62305.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin and moderate blue-gray cytoplasm. Several of these plasma cells contain slender, needle-shaped Auer-rod-like crystalline inclusions, and similar free crystals are scattered in the background, likely released from disrupted cells. No blasts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with intracytoplasmic crystalline inclusions; correlation with plasma cell quantitation, light-chain restriction and assessment for light-chain proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods are found in blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, not in cells with clock-face plasma-cell chromatin.
Crystal-storing histiocytes have abundant cytoplasm and small bland nuclei and are CD68/CD163 positive rather than CD138 positive.
Reactive plasma cells lack crystalline inclusions and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells and the slide in random planes, whereas true crystals are consistently intracytoplasmic and uniform in shape.

62177.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD4 對側向散射（SSC-A）點圖：84% 事件位於 CD4 陽性閘門，主要族群為 CD4 弱至中度陽性、SSC 中低，落在單核球區域，符合單核球系（monocytic）細胞擴增；CD4 單一抗原並不具系別特異性。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot of CD4 (x-axis, log) versus SSC-A (y-axis, linear), singlet-gated
CD4+ gate contains 84.00% of events
Dominant population with dim-to-moderate CD4 and low-intermediate SSC (monocytic region)
Smaller CD4-negative populations with low SSC (lymphocytes) and a scattered higher-SSC CD4-negative component
Tail of cells with higher SSC and CD4 expression extending upward
62177.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of peripheral blood singlets displays CD4 versus side scatter. The CD4-positive gate contains 84% of events, with the dominant population showing dim to moderate CD4 expression and low-to-intermediate side scatter, a pattern typical of monocytic cells, which express CD4 more weakly than helper T cells. CD4-negative events of low side scatter represent lymphocytes and other cells. CD4 alone is not lineage specific, and additional markers (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD36, HLA-DR, CD34/CD117) are required; in context, the plot supports an expanded monocytic population in acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: CD4+ T-cell proliferation (e.g. Sézary syndrome, T-PLL)
ddx.vs: T cells show bright CD4 with low SSC and co-express CD3, whereas monocytic cells are CD4 dim, CD3 negative and CD64/CD14 positive.
BPDCN is CD4+ CD56+ CD123 bright TCF4+ but lacks CD14, CD64 bright and MPO/lysozyme expression.

62049.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結正常結構消失，被多個大而模糊、邊緣不清的結節取代，結節內較淡染呈斑駁（moth-eaten）外觀，周圍為深染小淋巴球，這種大結節型態提示 NLPHL。
features: Effaced lymph node architecture replaced by large, ill-defined, back-to-back nodules
Nodules show a mottled paler appearance due to scattered larger cells and histiocytes within a small lymphocyte background
Internodular areas composed of densely packed small dark lymphocytes
Scattered small vessels and thin fibrous strands; no broad collagen bands
Cytologic detail of individual cells not assessable at this magnification
62049.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by large, vaguely defined nodules with a mottled, paler appearance set in a background of densely packed small lymphocytes. No broad sclerotic bands, sinuses, or normal reactive follicles are recognizable in this field. Individual cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; higher-power examination for LP cells and CD20, CD3, PD-1 and CD21/CD23 immunostains are needed to confirm the diagnosis and define the architectural pattern.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows numerous closely packed uniform follicles lacking mantle zones and composed of BCL2+ centrocytes, rather than few large mottled nodules with LP cells.
PTGC forms enlarged nodules within an otherwise reactive node with preserved normal follicles, and lacks LP cells.
Nodular LRCHL can look identical at low power and requires identification of CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells versus CD20+ LP cells.
Nodular mantle cell lymphoma is monotonous small cleaved cells expressing cyclin D1 and SOX11, without scattered large cells.

61985.recognize_zh: 八格免疫染色：大型腫瘤細胞 CD4 強陽性、CD43 膜陽性、CD2 弱而部分陽性，但 CD5、CD7、CD8、βF1（TCRβ）與 TCRδ 在大細胞上皆為陰性，只有背景小 T 細胞陽性；多個泛 T 標記缺失的 CD4+ 大細胞是 ALK 陰性 ALCL（含 BIA-ALCL）的典型表型。
features: Large pleomorphic tumor cells in a pale, fibrinous-appearing background
CD4: strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining of large tumor cells
CD43: strong membranous staining of large cells; CD2: weak, partial staining
CD5, CD7 and CD8: large cells negative, with only scattered small reactive T cells positive
βF1 (TCR beta) and TCR delta: large cells negative (loss of TCR expression)
Overall pattern: CD4+ T-cell phenotype with loss of multiple pan-T antigens and TCR
61985.describe_en: Panel of immunohistochemical stains on tissue with large pleomorphic tumor cells in a fibrinous background. The large cells are strongly positive for CD4 and CD43 and weakly, partially positive for CD2, while CD5, CD7, CD8, βF1 and TCR delta are negative in the tumor cells, with scattered small reactive T cells serving as internal positive controls. This profile indicates a CD4-positive T-cell neoplasm with loss of multiple pan-T-cell antigens and T-cell receptor expression. Findings are consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma, supporting breast implant-associated ALCL in the appropriate clinical setting, in conjunction with uniform CD30 positivity and ALK negativity.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks the uniform strong CD30 expression and hallmark cells of ALCL and more often retains TCR and several pan-T antigens.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells can lose T-cell markers but are usually CD15+ and weakly PAX5+, and lack CD4/CD43-positive cohesive sheets and effusion localization.
A reactive seroma contains a mixed population with preserved pan-T antigens and TCR expression, without monomorphic CD30+ large cells showing antigen loss.

61985.stain: IHC: CD2, CD4, CD5, CD7, CD8, CD43, βF1, TCRδ

61921.recognize_zh: 極低倍CD56染色的多塊胃腸道黏膜切片：其中一塊幾乎全片呈深棕色陽性，其他碎片呈斑駁至局部陽性，顯示CD56陽性細胞大量浸潤黏膜；此圖解析度低且模糊，無法評估細胞形態，只能看出浸潤的範圍。
features: Scanning-magnification view of several mucosal biopsy fragments stained for CD56
One fragment shows diffuse, intense CD56 positivity throughout the mucosa
Other fragments show patchy to moderate positivity in the lamina propria around negative gland profiles
Image is low resolution and blurred, precluding assessment of cell size, cytology or epitheliotropism
61921.describe_en: Scanning-power CD56 immunohistochemistry of multiple gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy fragments shows extensive CD56-positive infiltration, diffuse and intense in one fragment and patchy in the others, with negative gland profiles discernible within the stained lamina propria. The low resolution of the image does not permit evaluation of cytologic features, depth of involvement or angiodestruction. The distribution indicates a large mucosal NK-cell population; in conjunction with EBER negativity and a non-destructive histology, this is compatible with NK-cell enteropathy.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows the same CD56 positivity, so EBER positivity and necrotic angiodestructive growth are required to separate it.
MEITL is CD56-positive but is a transmural, epitheliotropic clonal T-cell lymphoma that cannot be excluded at this magnification without TCR studies.
A CD56-positive neuroendocrine tumor would be cytokeratin- and synaptophysin-positive and form organoid nests rather than a lamina propria infiltrate.

61793.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多個中大型細胞，細胞質帶稀疏或粗大的深紫色嗜鹼性顆粒並常覆蓋在核上，核形不規則、分葉不全或有切痕，部分顆粒明顯減少或只見空泡；這些是形態異常的嗜鹼性球（atypical basophils）。
features: Medium to large cells with round, indented, bilobed or irregularly folded nuclei and relatively fine to moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasmic granules are heterogeneous: coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules in some cells, sparse or absent granules (hypogranular) in others
Granules frequently overlie and obscure the nucleus, a basophil feature
Some cells show cytoplasmic vacuoles or clear halos where granules have dissolved, and a few have more abundant pale cytoplasm resembling immature forms
Background red cells without notable abnormality in the cropped tiles
61793.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood cells (panels A and B) demonstrates numerous atypical basophils. The cells are medium to large with irregular, indented or incompletely lobulated nuclei, and their cytoplasm contains variable, often reduced, coarse purple-black granules that overlie the nucleus, with vacuolated or degranulated areas in some cells. Several cells appear immature with less condensed chromatin and more cytoplasm. Such dysplastic, hypogranular basophils raise concern for a myeloid neoplasm and are suggestive of a myeloproliferative or MDS/MPN process; flow cytometry (CD123, CD203c, CD117, CD25) and BCR::ABL1 testing are needed to exclude CML and systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: May show identical basophils, so it is excluded by BCR::ABL1 FISH/PCR rather than morphology.

ddx.dx: Circulating mast cells (systemic mastocytosis or mast cell leukemia)
ddx.vs: Mast cells have round/oval non-lobulated nuclei, more numerous uniform metachromatic granules not overlying the nucleus, spindle shapes, and are tryptase+ CD117 bright CD25+ but CD123-/CD203c-dim.
Lack coarse metachromatic granules entirely and show CD123-negative, CD16/CD14 lineage-appropriate immunophenotypes.
Toxic granules are fine, evenly distributed in segmented neutrophils with Döhle bodies, and do not obscure the nucleus.

61729.recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 CD34 對 CD123 流式圖：綠色圈起的 M 群 CD123 陽性、CD34 陰性，與右下紅色 CD34 陽性、CD123 陰性至弱的正常前驅細胞明顯分開；CD34 陰性且 CD123 陽性的芽細胞群是 BPDCN 的關鍵表現。
features: Dot plot: CD34-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD123-APC (y-axis), gated on blasts
Gated abnormal population 'M' (green) CD123-positive and CD34-negative
Residual normal progenitors (red) CD34-bright with negative to dim CD123
Additional red CD34-negative/CD123-negative events (maturing cells) below the M gate
Clear separation between neoplastic and normal progenitor compartments
61729.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD34 versus CD123 gated on blasts shows a distinct abnormal population (gate M, green) that is CD123-positive and CD34-negative. Residual normal CD34-bright progenitors (red) show only negative to dim CD123 and are clearly separated from the abnormal population. A CD34-negative blast population with uniform CD123 expression is a key phenotypic feature of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm. Correlation with CD4, CD56, HLA-DR, TCF4/TCL1 and absence of MPO and lineage markers is needed for diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD123 expression
ddx.vs: CD123+ AML blasts usually co-express CD34 and/or CD117 with CD13/CD33, unlike this CD34-negative population.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell expansion in myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mature pDCs are CD123-bright and CD34-negative but CD56-negative, and are accompanied by a separate CD34+ myeloid clone.

61665.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量很多，顆粒球系與紅血球系各階段前驅細胞都增加（全骨髓增生，panmyelosis），並可見體積大、核分葉多的巨核細胞（下方中央及左上），這種三系增生加上大型巨核細胞的樣貌符合真性紅血球增多症的增生期，但需搭配 JAK2 突變與臨床數據。
features: Highly cellular aspirate with panmyelosis
Increased granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands
Erythroid precursors present in increased numbers with orderly maturation
Large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei (lower centre and upper left)
No increase in blasts and no obvious dysplasia in this field
61665.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is highly cellular with trilineage proliferation. Granulocytic precursors show full maturation, erythroid precursors are numerous with orderly maturation, and several large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei are present. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysplasia is evident. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera in the appropriate clinical and molecular context (elevated hemoglobin/hematocrit, JAK2 mutation).

ddx.vs: Secondary erythrocytosis shows isolated erythroid hyperplasia without granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation or large hyperlobated megakaryocytes, and has normal or high erythropoietin with no JAK2 mutation.
ET shows proliferation mainly of large to giant megakaryocytes with staghorn nuclei without significant granulocytic or erythroid panmyelosis.
Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic proliferation with reduced erythropoiesis and dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei, best assessed on the trephine.
CML shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with a myelocyte bulge, basophilia and small hypolobated dwarf megakaryocytes, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

61601.recognize_zh: 這張是免疫組織化學染色：大多數腫瘤細胞核呈強弱不一的棕色核染色，少數核只有藍色對比染色；標題未註明抗體，依此圖型態只能判定為高比例的核型標記（如 MUM1、Ki-67 或 MYC）陽性。
features: Nuclear DAB staining in the majority (roughly 70-80%) of tumor cell nuclei
Heterogeneous staining intensity from weak to strong between cells
No convincing membranous or cytoplasmic pattern
Interspersed negative hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei, including smaller background cells
Tumor cells arranged diffusely without architecture
61601.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows nuclear positivity in the majority of the neoplastic cells, with variable intensity, and a minor population of negative nuclei. The specific antibody is not stated in the record; the nuclear pattern and high proportion of positive cells would fit MUM1/IRF4, a high Ki-67 proliferation index, or MYC, each of which is typical of plasmablastic lymphoma. Interpretation should be tied to the labelled marker on the original slide. Findings are supportive of, but not by themselves diagnostic of, EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: A high nuclear Ki-67 or MYC index is shared, so separation relies on CD20/PAX5 positivity in DLBCL versus loss of B-cell markers with MUM1/CD138 expression in plasmablastic lymphoma.
Burkitt shows near 100% uniform Ki-67 staining with CD20/CD10 positivity and IG::MYC translocation, rather than CD20-negative plasmablastic immunophenotype.
Myeloma is also MUM1 positive but usually has a low Ki-67 index, is EBER negative and is marrow-based with an M-protein.

61473.recognize_zh: 中央一群中性球的細胞質內含粗大深紫色團塊（被吞噬的裂殖子或寄生蟲殘骸），周圍大量正常大小紅血球內有細小環狀體，常見一顆紅血球含多個環、雙染色質點與貼邊型，符合惡性瘧原蟲感染。
features: Cluster of neutrophils containing coarse dark purple cytoplasmic clumps, consistent with phagocytosed merozoites or parasite remnants
Neutrophil nuclei partly obscured by the inclusions; some cells appear degenerating
Heavy parasitemia with small delicate ring forms in normal-sized erythrocytes
Multiple rings per red cell, double chromatin dots and appliqué forms
No schizonts or gametocytes in this field; a few spherocytic or polychromatic red cells present
61473.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of neutrophils whose cytoplasm contains coarse, dark purple clumped material consistent with phagocytosed merozoites or parasite remnants.
