The background shows heavy parasitemia with numerous small, delicate ring forms in normal-sized erythrocytes, frequently multiple per cell, with double chromatin dots and appliqué forms. No schizonts or gametocytes are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with high parasitemia and neutrophil phagocytosis of parasite material.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, evenly distributed azurophilic granules, not the coarse clumped dark masses seen here in a malaria background.
Vivax infects enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and shows ameboid trophozoites and schizonts, rather than many small multiply infected normal-sized cells.
Babesia also causes multiple rings per cell but produces tetrads and extracellular forms without hemozoin pigment or neutrophil pigment.
Bacteria appear as uniform cocci or rods, whereas these inclusions are irregular clumps accompanying intraerythrocytic rings.

61409.recognize_zh: CD10 染色低倍（40x）見被纖維帶分隔的腫瘤結節瀰漫陽性、間質陰性；高倍（400x）為中大型細胞膜狀/胞質陽性，顯示生發中心表型，配合 MUM1 強陽性是 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤的特徵組合。
features: Low power (40x): diffuse CD10 staining throughout tumor nodules separated by negative fibrous septa
High power (400x): moderate to strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD10 in the majority of medium to large cells
Staining intensity somewhat heterogeneous with occasional weaker areas
Scattered positive cells within septa (few); stroma otherwise negative
61409.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous staining of the neoplastic medium to large lymphoid cells within nodules separated by negative fibrous septa. Expression involves the majority of tumor cells, indicating a germinal center B-cell phenotype. In combination with BCL6 and strong MUM1 co-expression, findings are consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement, pending FISH confirmation.

ddx.vs: FL is CD10+ but typically MUM1-negative and BCL2-positive with t(14;18), lacking IRF4 rearrangement.
Burkitt is CD10+ but composed of medium-sized cells with starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100%, BCL2-negative and MYC rearranged.
B-LBL may be CD10+ but expresses TdT and CD34 and lacks surface immunoglobulin.

61345.recognize_zh: 四個大型母細胞（blast）染色質細緻、細胞質中等量偏藍且無顆粒；箭頭所指的嗜中性球細胞質蒼白缺乏顆粒、核呈 C 形分葉不足，這種伴隨的發育不良提示母細胞屬骨髓系。
features: Four large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Adjacent neutrophil (arrow) with hypogranular, pale cytoplasm
Neutrophil nucleus hyposegmented, C-shaped band-like configuration with clumped chromatin
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
61345.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; Auer rods are not identified. An adjacent neutrophil is markedly hypogranular with a hyposegmented, C-shaped nucleus. The accompanying dysgranulopoiesis favors a myeloid lineage for the blasts, although lineage assignment requires cytochemistry or flow cytometry. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related features.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts lack accompanying dysplastic granulocytes and are MPO-negative with lymphoid markers on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huet change due to drugs (e.g., tacrolimus, mycophenolate)
ddx.vs: Drug-related hyposegmentation lacks a circulating blast population and resolves with drug withdrawal.

ddx.dx: Hypogranular neutrophils as smear artifact (EDTA storage)
ddx.vs: Artifact affects many neutrophils uniformly with degenerative vacuolation and is not accompanied by blasts.

61153.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 tryptase 免疫染色：大量中至大型細胞胞質呈強烈、顆粒狀棕色陽性，成片分布，部分為大型多核的陽性細胞；背景小型造血細胞為陰性，說明浸潤的主體是肥大細胞。
features: Numerous medium to large cells with strong granular cytoplasmic tryptase positivity forming confluent sheets
Staining intensity varies from moderate to very dark, with some round compact positive cells
Occasional very large positive cells with abundant cytoplasm, suggestive of multinucleated atypical mast cells
Intervening small hematopoietic cells with blue nuclei are tryptase-negative
Scattered fat spaces within a hypercellular marrow
61153.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy stained for tryptase shows a hypercellular marrow extensively infiltrated by medium to large cells with strong, granular cytoplasmic tryptase expression arranged in confluent sheets. Occasional very large positive cells with abundant cytoplasm are present, while the residual small hematopoietic cells are negative. The extent of tryptase-positive infiltration indicates a high mast cell burden, consistent with mast cell leukemia; aberrant CD25 and/or CD30 expression and KIT mutation status support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Basophilic blasts are immature, typically weak or negative for tryptase and negative for CD117, whereas neoplastic mast cells are strongly tryptase- and CD117-positive.

ddx.dx: Myelomastocytic leukemia or AML with increased tryptase-positive cells
ddx.vs: Tryptase-positive cells in myelomastocytic leukemia are immature and accompany ≥20% myeloblasts without meeting systemic mastocytosis criteria.
Reactive mast cells are scattered single, spindle or round tryptase-positive cells rather than dense aggregates or sheets.

61025.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆略大、淡藍灰色（多染性）的紅血球，整個細胞內均勻散布細小藍點（嗜鹼性點彩，basophilic stippling），另在邊緣有幾顆較粗、深色的顆粒（Pappenheimer 小體）；兩種包涵體在同一細胞中可互相對照。
features: Central slightly enlarged polychromatophilic red cell with fine blue dots evenly scattered throughout the cytoplasm (basophilic stippling)
A few coarser, darker granules clustered near the upper margin of the same cell (Pappenheimer bodies)
Anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes, teardrop-like cells, fragmented/triangular cells and a folded cell
Occasional cells with a dense crescentic hemoglobin distribution
Scattered normal-appearing platelets; no leukocytes in the field
61025.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes, occasional teardrop and fragmented forms, and scattered platelets. In the center, a polychromatophilic macrocyte contains fine basophilic stippling distributed diffusely through the cell together with a small peripheral group of coarser dark granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. Coexistence of stippling and siderotic granules suggests disordered erythropoiesis, as seen in sideroblastic anemia (including lead toxicity), thalassemia, myelodysplasia or hyposplenism; an iron stain on blood and marrow can confirm the Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: A Howell-Jolly body is a single, larger round DNA remnant rather than multiple fine or clustered granules.
Reticulocytes on Wright stain appear diffusely blue-grey without discrete punctate dots.

ddx.dx: Malaria (e.g., P. vivax with Schüffner dots)
ddx.vs: Schüffner stippling accompanies an identifiable parasite (ring, trophozoite or schizont) within an enlarged red cell.
Precipitate lies on top of and between cells in a different focal plane rather than being confined within the red cell.

60897.recognize_zh: CT 可見右側骨盆（髂骨）溶骨性合併軟組織腫塊（箭頭）；骨髓切片為瀰漫成片、中等大小、染色質細緻的芽細胞樣淋巴細胞，核染色（推測為 cyclin D3）大多強陽性，另一胞質染色（推測為 PTHrP）瀰漫強陽性，對應以高血鈣表現的母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: CT (A): destructive right pelvic bone lesion with associated soft tissue mass (arrow)
BM biopsy (B): hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with fine blastoid chromatin and scant cytoplasm
IHC (C): strong nuclear staining in the majority of tumor cells, compatible with cyclin D3
IHC (D): diffuse strong cytoplasmic staining of tumor cells, compatible with PTHrP
Residual fat spaces with near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis
60897.describe_en: Axial CT image shows a destructive lesion of the right pelvic bone with an associated soft tissue mass. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and diffusely replaced by sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with finely dispersed blastoid chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear positivity in most tumor cells (compatible with cyclin D3) and diffuse cytoplasmic positivity (compatible with parathyroid hormone-related protein); the specific antibodies are not labeled in the figure. In the stated context, findings are consistent with blastoid mantle cell lymphoma expressing cyclin D3 with PTHrP production causing hypercalcemia; SOX11 and CCND1/CCND2/CCND3 rearrangement studies are relevant for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT and CD34 positive and often CD10 positive, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT negative with CD5 and SOX11 expression.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli and lack SOX11 and cyclin D1/D2/D3 translocations.
Myeloma causes lytic lesions and hypercalcemia via osteoclast activation, but tumor cells are plasmacytoid, CD138 positive and CD20 negative.
AML blasts express MPO, CD117 or CD34 and lack B-cell markers.

60833.recognize_zh: 多顆紅血球內含細小、藍色環狀的寄生蟲，有時一顆紅血球內有多個或呈成對梨形；右下插圖可見四個蟲體排成十字形（Maltese cross，四聯體），而且沒有瘧原蟲的色素或配子體，符合巴貝西蟲症（babesiosis）。
features: Small intraerythrocytic ring forms with delicate blue cytoplasm and tiny chromatin dots
Some red cells contain multiple parasites, including paired and pleomorphic forms
Tetrad arrangement (Maltese cross) visible in the inset
No hemozoin pigment, Schüffner dots or gametocytes; infected red cells are not enlarged
Background shows red cell anisocytosis with some microspherocytic/dense cells and occasional crenated cells; scattered platelets
60833.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cell anisocytosis with scattered dense cells and small intraerythrocytic parasites. The organisms are small ring forms and pleomorphic piriform forms, several red cells harbor more than one parasite, and the inset shows a characteristic tetrad (Maltese cross) arrangement. Infected cells are not enlarged, and no malarial pigment, stippling or gametocytes are identified. Findings are consistent with babesiosis; parasitemia should be quantified and confirmed by PCR, particularly given the post-transplant, transfusion-exposed setting.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum shows ring forms with applique and double chromatin dots, banana-shaped gametocytes and hemozoin pigment, but never tetrads.
Superimposed platelets have granular purple centers, lie in a different focal plane and often show a halo, lacking a blue ring cytoplasm with chromatin dot.
These inclusions are solid dark basophilic dots (single for Howell-Jolly, clustered peripheral for Pappenheimer) without a ring or vacuolated center.

60769.recognize_zh: 單形小型淋巴球瀰漫性浸潤、被玻璃樣化血管分隔，中央可見一顆由多個深染核聚集成團的多核巨細胞（Warthin-Finkeldey 型），細胞質極少。
features: Monotonous diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant to moderate clear cytoplasm
A multinucleated giant cell with a tight cluster of hyperchromatic overlapping nuclei (Warthin-Finkeldey type) near the center, with a second less distinct one nearby
Branching small vessels with thick hyalinized eosinophilic walls
Occasional slightly larger cells with open chromatin, but no sheets of large cells
60769.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse effacement by monotonous small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant to moderate clear cytoplasm, separated by hyalinized small vessels. A multinucleated giant cell composed of a cluster of hyperchromatic overlapping nuclei with scant cytoplasm (Warthin-Finkeldey type) is present centrally. These polykaryocytes are non-specific and may be seen in reactive and neoplastic lymphoid proliferations. With a CD5-/CD10- clonal B-cell population, findings are consistent with nodal marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Warthin-Finkeldey cells are seen within hyperplastic germinal centers in a node with preserved architecture and polyclonal B cells.
Shows back-to-back neoplastic follicles of centrocytes and centroblasts that are CD10+/BCL6+, unlike this CD10-negative diffuse small-cell infiltrate.
Reed-Sternberg cells have abundant cytoplasm and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+, not dark-nucleated polykaryocytes.
Contains a prominent plasmacytoid and plasma cell component with MYD88 L265P, whereas marginal zone lymphoma usually lacks this mutation.

60577.recognize_zh: 周邊血液一個嗜中性球的細胞質內有數個小型卵圓酵母菌，菌體中央深紫、周圍有透明暈圈，大小一致約 2–4 µm；在血液抹片中看到白血球內的這種小酵母是播散性組織漿菌病的直接證據。
features: Neutrophil with lobated nucleus and fine granular cytoplasm
Several small (2-4 um) oval intracytoplasmic yeasts with dark purple crescent-shaped bodies and clear halos
Organisms are uniform in size, without capsule-like thick halo or kinetoplast
Red cells show poikilocytosis, including teardrop-like and elliptical forms and crenated echinocytes
60577.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil containing several small, uniform, oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms, each with a crescent-shaped basophilic body and a surrounding clear halo. Red cells show poikilocytosis with teardrop-shaped cells, elliptocytes and scattered crenated forms. Finding intracellular yeasts of this size in circulating leukocytes is consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis, typically in an immunocompromised host; buffy coat examination, Histoplasma antigen and blood cultures are recommended.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed platelets or Döhle bodies/toxic granules
ddx.vs: Platelets and toxic granules lack the uniform oval shape with a crescent body and surrounding clear halo seen in yeast forms.
Candida yeasts are larger with budding and pseudohyphae, and lack a halo.
Leishmania show both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and are rarely seen in circulating neutrophils.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny basophilic cocci without individual clear halos.

60641.recognize_zh: A 圖周邊血可見大小接近或超過紅血球、顆粒明顯的巨大血小板；B 圖骨髓抹片有發育異常的巨核細胞與成堆血小板，旁邊有芽細胞，提示伴巨血小板（類 Bernard-Soulier 症）之兒童骨髓分化不良症候群。
features: Panel A: giant platelets approaching or exceeding the size of red cells, with prominent central azurophilic granules
Panel A: background red cells normocytic with central pallor; otherwise sparse platelets
Panel B: dysplastic megakaryocyte with platelet budding/clumped platelet aggregates
Panel B: immature cells with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin consistent with blasts, plus a large mononuclear cell and occasional dysplastic granulocytic precursors
Image resolution limits detailed assessment of megakaryocyte nuclear lobation
60641.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows giant platelets, some equal to or larger than adjacent red cells, with conspicuous granules. The bone marrow aspirate shows a dysplastic megakaryocyte associated with clumps of platelets, together with immature blast-like cells and dysplastic myeloid precursors; resolution limits precise dysplasia grading and a blast count is not possible from this field. Giant platelets with impaired ristocetin agglutination can reflect acquired glycoprotein Ib/IX deficiency in a dysplastic megakaryocytic clone. Findings are consistent with childhood myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts associated with an acquired Bernard-Soulier–like platelet dysfunction.

ddx.vs: Congenital BSS has lifelong giant platelets and GPIb-IX-V gene mutations but a normal marrow without dysplasia or excess blasts.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and no marrow dysplasia.
ITP shows large young platelets with increased but morphologically normal megakaryocytes, without blasts or multilineage dysplasia.
AMKL has ≥20% megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs (CD41/CD61+) and often marrow fibrosis, beyond the blast range of MDS.

60705.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型細胞緊密聚集成團、彼此以細胞邊界相貼，外觀像轉移性癌細胞團；但細胞質灰藍、核卵圓、染色質細緻且有小核仁，屬於淋巴瘤細胞的黏聚假象，需以免疫表型確認為肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Cohesive-appearing clusters of large atypical cells with molded cell borders, mimicking epithelial tumor clumps
Oval to reniform nuclei with fine to slightly granular chromatin and one or more small nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm, occasionally with small vacuoles and faint granularity
Relatively uniform (monomorphic) population within each cluster
Background peripheral red cells, a neutrophil and scattered small erythroid/lymphoid cells outside the clusters
60705.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears contain tight clusters of large atypical cells with molded borders, oval to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm. The clumping pattern closely mimics metastatic carcinoma or a small round cell tumor, but the cells show hematolymphoid rather than epithelial cytologic features, without gland formation or mucin. Flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry (CD45, CD3, TCRγδ, cytokeratin) is required; with a CD3+, CD4−/CD8−, TCRγδ+ phenotype, findings are consistent with hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma mimicking bone marrow metastasis.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are truly cohesive with acinar/glandular arrangements, cytokeratin positivity and CD45 negativity, unlike these CD45+/CD3+ lymphoma cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These form rosettes or syncytial clumps in children, are CD45-negative and express neural or myogenic markers (synaptophysin, myogenin).
ALCL shows more pleomorphic hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong CD30 (±ALK), while HSTCL cells are monomorphic, CD30-negative γδ T cells in sinusoids.
Myeloblasts rarely cluster, may have Auer rods and are MPO/CD33/CD117 positive rather than surface CD3 positive.

captions: Aspirate: cluster of large atypical cells with molded borders beside a neutrophil
Aspirate: tightly packed cluster mimicking metastatic tumor
Aspirate: cohesive group with oval nuclei and small nucleoli
Aspirate: clump of monomorphic lymphoma cells with pale cytoplasm

60513.recognize_zh: 大型淋巴球的核偏向細胞一側，上方有大片淡染細胞質，邊緣被周圍紅血球壓出凹痕且外緣帶藍色，染色質中度濃縮，是反應性淋巴球（Downey II 型）的樣貌。
features: Large lymphocyte with oval, eccentrically placed nucleus
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleolus
Abundant pale cytoplasm with a thin deeper blue rim at the periphery
Irregular cytoplasmic outline indented by surrounding red cells
Few fine pink granules in the pale cytoplasm; background normocytic red cells
60513.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an eccentric oval nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin and no prominent nucleolus. The abundant cytoplasm is pale centrally with a thin rim of deeper basophilia at the margin, and its outline is indented by adjacent red cells. Occasional fine pink granules are present. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphocyte (Downey type II morphology).

ddx.vs: Monocytes show folded nuclei with delicate lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles, without peripheral basophilic hugging of red cells.
LGLs have several coarse discrete azurophilic granules and a round non-eccentric nucleus rather than a basophilic scalloped margin.
Hairy cells show fine circumferential cytoplasmic projections and form a monotonous population with monocytopenia, confirmed by CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1.
Plasmacytoid cells have denser clumped chromatin and uniformly deep blue cytoplasm rather than pale cytoplasm with a basophilic rim.

60449.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央這顆嗜中性球的核只分成兩葉、以細橋相連（眼鏡狀，pince-nez），染色質粗塊狀，細胞質顆粒明顯稀少；這種低分葉、少顆粒的假性 Pelger-Huët 嗜中性球是骨髓發育不良（MDS）的典型形態線索。
features: Single neutrophil with bilobed nucleus (pince-nez/spectacle shape) joined by a thin chromatin bridge
Coarsely clumped, condensed nuclear chromatin
Hypogranular cytoplasm with only sparse fine pink granules
Background of mostly normocytic red cells with mild anisocytosis; platelets appear decreased
No blasts in this field; leukocytes sparse, consistent with cytopenia
60449.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows sparse leukocytes and few platelets. The single neutrophil in the field has a bilobed, pince-nez nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm, representing a hypogranular pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophil. Red cells show mild anisocytosis without schistocytes or circulating blasts. In a patient with pancytopenia, monosomy 7 and germline GATA2 mutation, this dysplastic neutrophil supports myelodysplasia, consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, GATA2 deficiency-related.

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation in a patient without cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset and often hypogranular.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., mycophenolate, valproate, taxanes)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; drug history and resolution after withdrawal distinguish it, while clonal cytogenetics support MDS.

ddx.dx: Normal band or bilobed neutrophil / eosinophil
ddx.vs: Normal bilobed cells have finer chromatin and full granulation (orange granules in eosinophils), unlike this hypogranular cell with coarse clumped chromatin.

60385.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，背景大量小淋巴球為陰性（藍色核），只有散在的大型細胞呈細胞膜環狀加上核旁點狀（高基氏體，Golgi）陽性；這種「膜＋Golgi」染色的大細胞即 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞，在 CLL/SLL 背景中出現代表霍奇金型 Richter 轉化。
features: CD30 IHC with scattered large cells showing membranous rim staining
Distinct paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) positivity in many large cells
Large cells with vesicular nuclei, some binucleate/multilobated (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like), singly and in small groups
Background small lymphocytes and histiocytes CD30-negative
No sheets of CD30-positive cells
60385.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry highlights scattered large cells with a membranous pattern and prominent paranuclear Golgi-zone dot positivity, distributed singly and in small loose clusters. These cells have large vesicular nuclei and occasionally appear binucleated or multilobated. The background small lymphocytes and histiocytes are negative. In a patient with small lymphocytic lymphoma, CD30-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-type cells in this pattern support Richter transformation of Hodgkin lymphoma type, particularly if accompanied by CD15 positivity, weak/absent B-cell program and EBV positivity.

ddx.dx: CLL/SLL with scattered HRS-like cells (no true cHL)
ddx.vs: HRS-like cells scattered within a background of CLL cells without a distinct polymorphous cHL microenvironment are classified separately; true Hodgkin-type Richter shows HRS cells in a mixed inflammatory T-cell/histiocyte background.
ALCL forms cohesive sheets of CD30-strong hallmark cells, often sinusoidal, with T-cell/cytotoxic markers and frequently ALK, rather than scattered HRS cells.
DLBCL-type Richter shows sheets of large B cells with strong CD20/PAX5 and usually variable or negative CD30.
Reactive immunoblasts are smaller, lack classic HRS nuclear features and show weaker, more heterogeneous CD30 without CD15 or loss of B-cell program.

60193.recognize_zh: CD34免疫染色中，棕色陽性的是散布於造血細胞間的單核小圓細胞（芽細胞），數量明顯多於正常骨髓，部分聚成小群；另有沿血管排列的拉長陽性細胞是內皮細胞，計算芽細胞時要排除。
features: Moderately to markedly hypercellular marrow with scattered adipocytes
Numerous CD34-positive (brown membranous/cytoplasmic) small round mononuclear cells consistent with blasts
Blasts are dispersed interstitially with occasional small clusters, not forming confluent sheets
Some elongated CD34-positive cells trace capillaries/sinusoids (endothelial internal control)
Megakaryocytes and most maturing hematopoietic cells are CD34-negative
60193.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine section shows a hypercellular marrow with an increased number of CD34-positive round mononuclear cells, distributed interstitially with occasional small clusters. Elongated CD34-positive cells lining vessels represent endothelium and serve as an internal positive control. Megakaryocytes and maturing cells are negative, and there are no confluent sheets of blasts. The staining pattern supports an increase in marrow blasts, consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts when correlated with the aspirate blast count (10–19% for the former RAEB-2 category).

ddx.vs: AML shows ≥20% blasts, usually as confluent sheets of CD34-positive cells rather than scattered interstitial positivity.
Normal marrow has only rare (<2–3%) interstitial CD34-positive cells apart from endothelium, without clusters.
Monoblasts, promonocytes and promyelocytes are often CD34-negative, so a low CD34 count can underestimate blasts; morphology and CD117/lysozyme help.
In fibrotic marrow CD34 highlights many elongated vessel-lining cells, which must not be counted as blasts.

60129.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中約八個小圓形腫瘤細胞呈花瓣狀環繞在中央淡藍色纖維物質周圍，形成 Homer Wright 假玫瑰花結（rosette），是神經母細胞瘤轉移至骨髓的典型線索。
features: Cluster of about eight small round tumor cells arranged radially around a central core
Central pale-blue fibrillary material (neuropil) forming a Homer Wright-type pseudorosette
High N:C ratio with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and nuclear molding
Scant cytoplasm merging with the central fibrillary core
Background red cells show crenation/artifact; an adjacent histiocyte-like cell with vacuolated cytoplasm
60129.describe_en: High-power view of a Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive group of small round tumor cells arranged radially around a central core of pale blue fibrillary material, forming a Homer Wright-type pseudorosette. The tumor cells have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely granular chromatin and nuclear molding. Background red cells show drying artifact. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte with surrounding cells (emperipolesis) or clumped blasts
ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has a single large lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm, and leukemic blasts do not form rosettes around fibrillary cores.
Ewing sarcoma can form rosettes but usually lacks true neuropil and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 fusion.
These also form rosettes but differ in age, primary site and immunoprofile (PHOX2B negative).
ALL blasts are discohesive, without rosettes or neuropil, and are CD45/TdT positive.

60065.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小形狀差異極大，有淚滴狀、橢圓、碎片與小球形細胞，並混有部分偏淡染的紅血球（雙相性 dimorphic 族群）；視野正中一顆紅血球布滿粗大藍紫色顆粒（coarse basophilic stippling），這組合提示鐵粒母細胞性貧血等血紅素合成障礙。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes, fragmented cells, and microspherocytic forms
Dimorphic red cell population with a subset of hypochromic cells alongside normochromic cells
Central red cell with dense coarse basophilic stippling (possibly with Pappenheimer bodies)
Platelets reduced; no leukocytes in this field
Nucleated red cells and polychromasia are not evident in this particular field
60065.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells, elliptocytes, fragmented red cells, and small dense forms. There is a dimorphic red cell population with a subset of hypochromic cells, and a red cell in the center contains coarse basophilic stippling that may include Pappenheimer bodies. Nucleated red cells and polychromasia are not seen in this field, and platelets appear decreased. Findings are consistent with a disorder of ineffective erythropoiesis/heme synthesis and are suggestive of sideroblastic anemia in this clinical context; an iron stain of the marrow (and Prussian blue on the smear for siderocytes) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Also shows microcytosis, target cells, and basophilic stippling, but the red cells are uniformly microcytic rather than dimorphic, HbA2/HbF are increased, and marrow lacks ring sideroblasts.
Produces coarse basophilic stippling and ring sideroblasts, but is acquired with elevated blood lead and less marked poikilocytosis.
Teardrop cells are accompanied by a leukoerythroblastic picture with circulating myeloid precursors and marrow fibrosis.
Can produce a dimorphic picture, but hypochromic microcytes lack coarse stippling/Pappenheimer bodies and ferritin is low.

26721.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的偏心核、核周淡染區的漿細胞，其中有漿細胞胞質內吞入一個被空泡包圍的細胞（B 箭頭）及紅血球碎片（C 箭頭）；切片（D）亦見漿細胞片狀浸潤、胞質內含紅血球（箭頭），顯示腫瘤性漿細胞的吞噬現象。
features: Aspirate with increased clustered plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and basophilic cytoplasm, some binucleate or with nucleoli
Plasma cell containing an engulfed nucleated cell surrounded by a clear vacuole (panel B, arrow)
Plasma cell with phagocytosed red cells/red cell fragments within cytoplasmic vacuoles (panel C, arrow)
Core biopsy (H&E) with sheets of plasma cells, several containing intracytoplasmic erythrocytes (panel D, arrows)
26721.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows increased plasma cells, many in clusters, with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear clearing and occasional nucleoli or binucleation. Several plasma cells contain phagocytosed material, including an intact nucleated cell within a vacuole and erythrocytes or erythrocyte fragments. The trephine biopsy shows an interstitial-to-sheet-like infiltrate of plasma cells, some with intracytoplasmic red cells. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with hemophagocytosis by neoplastic plasma cells; CD138 and light chain studies would confirm clonality and cell identity.

ddx.vs: In HLH the phagocytes are macrophages with abundant pale cytoplasm and bland reniform nuclei (CD68+/CD163+, CD138−), not clonal plasma cells with a hof.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are homogeneous pale-blue or pink immunoglobulin globules, not recognizable red cells or nucleated cells.
Emperipolesis occurs within large multilobated megakaryocytes, not within small eccentric-nucleated plasma cells.
RDD shows emperipolesis by large S100+/CD68+ histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm rather than by CD138+ plasma cells.

18913.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中可見細長蜷曲的線狀蟲體，體內充滿一整列深藍色細胞核，外圍有淡色鞘膜（sheath），為微絲蚴（microfilaria）；此圖本身看不到明確的瘧原蟲，合併瘧疾需另看紅血球內寄生蟲。
features: Elongated coiled worm-like organism, many times longer than red cells (microfilaria)
Column of densely packed, dark blue-purple somatic nuclei along the body
Pale, clear to faintly pink sheath surrounding the body in panel A (sheathed microfilaria)
Panel B: undulating microfilaria lying in a clear space of a blood film
Tail tip nuclear pattern cannot be assessed; no intraerythrocytic malaria parasites are clearly resolved
18913.describe_en: Peripheral blood films show microfilariae: panel A contains a coiled larva with a column of densely packed nuclei enclosed by a pale sheath, and panel B shows an undulating larva in a thinner area of the film. The tail region and cephalic space cannot be evaluated at this magnification, so species identification (e.g., Wuchereria bancrofti versus Brugia malayi) is not possible from this image. Malaria parasites are not clearly identified in these panels, so the concomitant Plasmodium infection must be documented on separate fields or by antigen testing. Findings are consistent with sheathed microfilaremia, most likely lymphatic filariasis in this clinical setting.

ddx.vs: B. malayi has a sheath that stains pink with Giemsa and two separate terminal tail nuclei, whereas W. bancrofti has an often unstained sheath and a tail tip free of nuclei.
Loa loa is sheathed but has nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip, a daytime periodicity and an African travel history.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller and unsheathed with nuclei extending to a blunt tail.
Contaminating fibers lack internal nuclei and a sheath.

21857.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片低倍即見紅髓內布滿成團的組織球，細胞質內含大小不一、邊界清楚的空泡（像瑞士起司），插圖中空泡性組織球圍繞小血管形成脂肪肉芽腫（lipogranuloma），符合矽膠外漏引起的脂肪肉芽腫。
features: Low power: congested red pulp with numerous nodular aggregates of vacuolated histiocytes (lipogranulomas)
Histiocytes contain multiple sharply punched-out, variably sized clear vacuoles (Swiss-cheese appearance)
Preserved white pulp follicle (upper right) and fibrous trabeculae
Inset: vacuolated histiocytes and clear spaces surrounding a small vessel with a rim of epithelioid cells
No necrosis, organisms or atypical neoplastic cells evident
21857.describe_en: Splenic sections show congested red pulp extensively infiltrated by nodular aggregates of histiocytes containing numerous clear, sharply defined vacuoles of varying size, imparting a Swiss-cheese appearance. White pulp follicles and trabeculae are preserved. At higher power, vacuolated histiocytes and extracellular clear spaces cluster around small vessels, forming lipogranulomas without necrosis or atypical cells. In the setting of ruptured silicone breast implants, findings are consistent with silicone-induced lipogranulomatosis of the spleen causing hypersplenism.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm without discrete clear vacuoles and are associated with glucocerebrosidase deficiency.

ddx.dx: Niemann-Pick disease or other lipid storage histiocytosis
ddx.vs: Storage cells have uniformly finely foamy cytoplasm rather than large punched-out vacuoles of variable size.
Mineral oil lipogranulomas look identical and are common incidental findings, so the discriminator is exposure history and chemical analysis.
Signet ring cells have a crescentic atypical nucleus compressed by mucin and are cytokeratin-positive.

21729.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中除了染色質塊狀的小型 CLL 淋巴球外，還有較大、核染色質細緻、細胞質稀少的芽細胞（箭頭）；流式 CD45 對側散射圖可見一群 CD45 較弱（dim）的族群與 CD45 強陽性淋巴球分開，提示兩種腫瘤細胞並存。
features: Panel A: larger blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm (arrows)
Admixed small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin (CLL background) and a smudge cell
Many crenated red cells in the background
Panel B: CD45 versus side scatter plot with a dominant CD45-dim/negative, low side-scatter population (blue)
Separate CD45-bright low side-scatter lymphocyte gate (27.3%) and few granulocytes (9.0%)
21729.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two lymphoid populations: small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and smudge cells, and larger blasts with fine chromatin, scant cytoplasm and a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. Flow cytometry (CD45 versus side scatter) demonstrates a large CD45-dim, low side-scatter population distinct from a CD45-bright mature lymphocyte cluster. Findings are consistent with a precursor B-lymphoblastic leukemia co-circulating with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; full immunophenotyping (CD19, CD10, CD34, TdT versus CD5/CD23/light chain) and clonality studies are needed to establish whether the two processes are clonally related.

ddx.dx: Richter transformation or prolymphocytic progression of CLL
ddx.vs: Transformed CLL cells remain CD45-bright, CD5/CD23-positive and TdT/CD34-negative, whereas lymphoblasts are CD45-dim and TdT-positive.
Myeloblasts share the CD45-dim gate but express MPO, CD13/CD33 and CD117 rather than CD19/CD10/TdT.
Blastoid MCL is CD5-positive, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and TdT-negative.

15201.recognize_zh: 深膚色病人的背部與軀幹散布多個略隆起、呈紫灰色至色素沉著的浸潤性斑塊與成群小丘疹，部分斑塊表面粗糙呈苔蘚化，這種以毛囊為中心的浸潤性病灶符合親毛囊型蕈狀肉芽腫（folliculotropic MF）。
features: Clinical photograph of the back in a darkly pigmented patient
Multiple scattered, slightly elevated, violaceous-gray to hyperpigmented infiltrated plaques of varying size
Clusters of small grouped papules coalescing into plaques, suggestive of follicular accentuation
Some plaques with rough, lichenified or scaly surface; lesions concentrated on lower back and scapular areas
No ulcerated tumors visible, consistent with limited-stage (IB) disease
15201.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows the back of a darkly pigmented patient with numerous scattered, slightly raised, violaceous-gray to hyperpigmented infiltrated plaques and clusters of small grouped papules, some with a rough, lichenified surface. No tumors or ulceration are present, and body surface involvement exceeds 10%. Follicular plugging or alopecia cannot be definitively assessed at this resolution. Findings are consistent with folliculotropic mycosis fungoides, stage IB; biopsy showing folliculotropic atypical CD4+ T cells with or without follicular mucinosis is required, and folliculotropic MF behaves more aggressively than classic patch/plaque MF.

ddx.vs: Classic MF shows epidermotropism with Pautrier microabscesses and sparing of hair follicles, while folliculotropic MF shows atypical T cells infiltrating follicular epithelium, often with mucin deposition.
Lichenoid eruptions show a band-like lymphocytic interface dermatitis with Civatte bodies and polyclonal T cells, without folliculotropic atypical lymphocytes.
Idiopathic follicular mucinosis occurs as few lesions in younger patients without clonal atypical T-cell infiltrates.
Cutaneous sarcoidosis shows non-caseating dermal granulomas without atypical folliculotropic lymphocytes.

3041.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的血性背景中散布多個緻密、深藍色的細胞團塊，大小遠超過造血細胞群且邊界清楚，這種黏合性團塊是轉移性癌侵犯骨髓的低倍線索，需再放大確認細胞形態。
features: Low-power view with multiple dense, dark blue cohesive cell clusters
Clusters are discrete with sharp outlines against a blood-rich background
Few dispersed single hematopoietic cells between the clusters
Occasional small fat vacuoles adjacent to clusters
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
3041.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows multiple discrete, densely cellular, dark-staining cohesive clusters within a blood-rich background, with relatively few dispersed hematopoietic cells. At this magnification cytologic detail cannot be evaluated, but the tight clustering pattern differs from marrow particles and is suggestive of metastatic tumor; in a patient with prostatic adenocarcinoma, findings are consistent with marrow involvement, to be confirmed on high power and by PSA/NKX3.1 immunohistochemistry on the core biopsy.

ddx.vs: Marrow particles contain fat spaces and mixed hematopoietic cells that disperse at the edges, rather than tight dark uniform clusters.
Platelet aggregates are pale purple and granular without nuclei, which high power would demonstrate.

ddx.dx: Clustered plasma cell myeloma or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid neoplasms are usually discohesive and rarely form tight clusters; high-power cytology and IHC distinguish them.

1185.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球淡染、略呈藍灰色，細胞內散布許多細小深色點狀顆粒（basophilic stippling，核糖體聚集）；背景可見標靶細胞、淚滴細胞與多染性紅血球，需聯想鉛中毒、地中海貧血等。
features: Arrowed red cell with numerous fine, evenly distributed dark punctate granules throughout the cell
Stippled cell appears pale with faint bluish (polychromatic) tint
Background target cells and hypochromic red cells
Occasional teardrop cell and a larger polychromatophilic red cell
No leukocytes in this field
1185.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, occasional teardrop forms and polychromatophilic red cells. A red cell (arrow) contains numerous fine, diffusely distributed dark blue punctate granules consistent with basophilic stippling, representing aggregated ribosomal RNA. Stippling is distinguished from Pappenheimer bodies by its diffuse distribution and small uniform granules. Findings are consistent with basophilic stippling, which in this context raises consideration of thalassemia, lead poisoning, pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency or dyserythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few, larger, clustered granules at the cell periphery and are Prussian blue positive, unlike diffuse fine stippling.

ddx.dx: Malaria (early Plasmodium stages or Schüffner dots)
ddx.vs: Parasitized cells contain ring forms with chromatin dots and cytoplasm, and Schüffner dots are pink and accompany an enlarged host cell.
Howell-Jolly bodies are usually single, round, larger dense purple nuclear remnants rather than many fine granules.

ddx.dx: Platelets or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Stain debris lies in a different focal plane and also appears between cells, while stippling is confined within the red cell.

3745.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一大片由無數細小紫色顆粒狀血小板聚集而成、沒有細胞核的團塊，周圍是各階段骨髓系細胞，是血小板凝集（platelet clump）而非巨核細胞。
features: Large anucleate aggregate of numerous individual platelets with purple granular centers
Platelets are discrete and closely packed within a pale blue-gray amorphous matrix
Few small refractile golden-brown deposits within the aggregate (pigment or debris)
Surrounding myeloid precursors at various stages, segmented neutrophils, and a granulated promyelocyte
Scattered erythrocytes in the background
3745.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large aggregate of closely packed platelets without an associated megakaryocyte nucleus, admixed with a few small golden-brown refractile deposits. The surrounding cells are maturing granulocytic precursors and segmented neutrophils without an obvious abnormal population. Findings represent a platelet clump, which in aspirate smears is common and should not be mistaken for a megakaryocyte or microorganisms.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has a large lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm in continuity, whereas this aggregate consists of separate platelets without a nucleus.

ddx.dx: Fungal yeasts or other organisms in a clump
ddx.vs: Organisms have uniform size, a capsule or halo, and budding, unlike the variably sized granular platelets here.
Mast cell granules are deep purple-black and densely fill a cell with a central nucleus rather than forming a loose anucleate aggregate.

1825.recognize_zh: 三顆嗜中性球周圍都環繞著一圈小血小板（platelet satellitism），而遠離白血球處幾乎沒有游離血小板，這是 EDTA 依賴性假性血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）的典型表現；紅血球上的透明折光點為乾燥假影。
features: Platelets rosetting around three separate neutrophils (platelet satellitism)
Platelets are normal-sized with granular centers; very few free platelets away from neutrophils
Neutrophils otherwise morphologically normal
Red cells show refractile clear inclusions and crenation from slow-drying artifact
No schistocytes, giant platelets, or large fibrin-platelet clumps evident
1825.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows platelets encircling three neutrophils, forming platelet satellitism, with very few free-lying platelets elsewhere in the field. The platelets are normal in size and the neutrophils are otherwise unremarkable. Red cells show refractile drying artifact but no schistocytes. Platelet satellitism sequesters platelets from automated counting, producing a spuriously low count. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia; a citrate-anticoagulated platelet count is recommended.

ddx.vs: Genuinely low platelet counts show sparse platelets without neutrophil rosettes, and the count stays low in citrate tubes.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed platelets (e.g., in sepsis or immune thrombocytopenia)
ddx.vs: Engulfed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm, whereas satellitism shows platelets adherent to the outer cell membrane.

ddx.dx: Bacteria or fungal organisms adherent to neutrophils
ddx.vs: Organisms have uniform shape and staining without the granular chromomere and pale hyalomere of platelets.

1313.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的母細胞胞質深藍，邊緣呈毛邊狀、拉出細絲或泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods），其中一顆胞質內有空泡；這種帶胞質突起的母細胞是巨核母細胞的經典外觀，在唐氏症病童即 ML-DS。
features: Medium-sized blasts with round nuclei, high N:C ratio and finely granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with frayed borders, blebs and thread-like projections
Cytoplasmic vacuole in one blast
Indistinct nucleoli at this magnification
Background red cells largely normocytic without nucleated forms in this field
1313.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating blasts. The blasts are medium-sized with round nuclei, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and finely granular chromatin, and they have deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with irregular frayed borders, cytoplasmic blebs, thread-like projections and an occasional vacuole. Background red cells are unremarkable in this field. The cytoplasmic blebbing is characteristic of megakaryoblasts; in a child with Down syndrome, the findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome, pending CD41/CD61 immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Indistinguishable blasts; TAM occurs in the first weeks of life and regresses without therapy.
Lymphoblasts have smooth cytoplasmic outlines without blebs and lack platelet glycoprotein expression.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections but mature oval nuclei with open chromatin and pale gray-blue cytoplasm, and are CD11c/CD103/annexin A1-positive B cells in adults.

1121.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆中型淋巴球，胞質為強嗜鹼性並有突出的小泡狀胞質突起（cytoplasmic bleb，箭頭），核圓或略不規則，是 T-PLL 的特徵。
features: Increased small-to-medium lymphoid cells with moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin; small nucleoli in some cells
Intensely basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs (arrow)
Background normochromic red cells and platelets without smudge cells
1121.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and agranular, and several cells show cytoplasmic blebs or protrusions (arrow). Smudge cells are not a feature in this field. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry (CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7 positive; often CD4+) and TCL1A rearrangement (inv(14)/t(14;14)).

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-cell prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and less basophilic cytoplasm without blebs, and express B-cell markers.
Hairy cells have pale gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei, and are CD103/CD25/CD11c positive.
ATLL cells are highly convoluted 'flower cells' and patients are HTLV-1 positive.

1057.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆大型母細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻，周邊僅一圈深藍胞質，右側可見一顆深色顆粒的嗜鹼性球；在 CML 周邊血出現母細胞與嗜鹼性球，提示加速期或急性轉化。
features: Large blast with very high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Blast has an angular outline from smear flattening; no granules or Auer rods visible
Basophil with coarse dark granules at the right edge
Red cells with central clearing artifacts; platelet clumps and giant platelets in the background
1057.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods are seen. A basophil is present at the edge of the field, and platelets form small clumps. Red cells show central clearing artifact. In the context of relapsed CML, findings are consistent with circulating blasts and basophilia, supporting accelerated or blast phase; lineage assignment of blasts requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may look similar with scant agranular cytoplasm, so flow cytometry (CD19/CD10/TdT versus MPO/CD13/CD33) is needed to assign lineage.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61 positive, which cannot be excluded morphologically in a single cell.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and coarser chromatin than blasts.

4065.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現大量中型淋巴球，核質比高、核形不規則，細胞質嗜鹼性且有明顯的細胞質突起（cytoplasmic blebs），並伴隨破碎細胞（smudge cells），符合 T-PLL 的典型樣貌。
features: Increased medium-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular to slightly indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; small nucleolus in some
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with characteristic surface blebs/protrusions
Several smudge/crushed cells
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes, likely artifact) and occasional neutrophils
4065.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of medium-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli. The scant cytoplasm is basophilic and forms distinct surface blebs. Smudge cells are present, and red cells show crenation. Findings are suggestive of T-prolymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD4/CD8, CD7 bright) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement testing are required.

ddx.vs: B-cell cells show a single prominent nucleolus without cytoplasmic blebs and express CD19/CD20, not T-cell antigens.
ATLL cells have polylobated flower-shaped nuclei and are HTLV-1 positive, CD25+, usually CD7-negative.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with inconspicuous cytoplasm and are CD7/CD26-negative, whereas T-PLL is typically CD7 bright.

4193.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中，破裂巨噬細胞周圍散布許多 2–4 µm 的卵圓形小體，每個都有一個核與一個棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），即 Leishmania 無鞭毛體（LD bodies）。
features: Numerous small (2-4 um) oval organisms clustered near a disrupted macrophage
Each organism with a purple nucleus and a small rod-shaped kinetoplast
Organisms largely extracellular due to smear disruption, some overlying cell cytoplasm
Surrounding hematopoietic cells including myelocytes and immature forms
Pale background with out-of-focus red cells
4193.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous small oval intracellular and extracellular organisms clustered around a disrupted histiocyte. Each organism measures a few microns and contains a nucleus and a distinct rod-like kinetoplast. Background hematopoietic cells are present. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies), supporting visceral leishmaniasis; PCR or culture can confirm the species.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic and lack a kinetoplast.
Platelets are granular without an organized nucleus-kinetoplast pair and vary in shape.

3873.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，許多呈棕色細胞質染色、帶樹突狀突起的組織球散布於整片骨髓間質，顯示組織球數量增加；本圖未見明確成形的肉芽腫，所用抗體未標示，推測為組織球標記。
features: Numerous scattered brown cytoplasmic-positive cells with irregular, dendritic-like processes
Positive cells distributed interstitially, with a vague central concentration
Granular brown staining of cytoplasm consistent with a histiocytic marker
No discrete compact granuloma outline in this field
Background hematopoietic cells and adipocytes negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
3873.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows numerous scattered cells with granular brown cytoplasmic staining and irregular, dendritic-like processes distributed interstitially throughout the marrow, with a vague central concentration. The specific antibody is not indicated, but the staining pattern is consistent with a histiocytic marker such as CD68 or CD163. A compact granuloma is not delineated in this field, and organisms cannot be assessed on this stain. Findings indicate an increased interstitial histiocytic population, compatible with the loose granulomatous response of disseminated histoplasmosis.

ddx.vs: HLH also increases CD163-positive macrophages, but shows hemophagocytosed blood cells without intracellular yeasts on H&E or GMS.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a and langerin positive, unlike CD68/CD163-positive macrophages.
Mast cells form spindle cell aggregates and stain with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 rather than macrophage markers.
Leukemic monocytes form diffuse sheets that are also CD68/CD163 positive but show blast cytology on aspirate and flow cytometry.

3617.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆嗜中性球，分葉核旁的細胞質內有兩小團深紫色、顆粒狀的包涵體（morulae），與細胞核分開、質地呈細點狀；出現在嗜中性球中，符合 Anaplasma phagocytophilum（顆粒球無形體症／人類顆粒球 ehrlichiosis）。
features: Neutrophil with lobulated nucleus and fine pink cytoplasmic granules
Two small, stippled, deep purple intracytoplasmic inclusions (morulae) adjacent to the nucleus
Inclusions have granular texture distinct from the homogeneous nuclear chromatin
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes) and a single platelet
3617.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a neutrophil containing two small, stippled, deep purple intracytoplasmic inclusions adjacent to, but separate from, the lobulated nucleus. The inclusions have a finely granular texture distinct from nuclear chromatin, consistent with morulae. Background red cells show crenation artifact, and platelets are sparse. Findings are consistent with human granulocytic anaplasmosis (Anaplasma phagocytophilum); confirmation by PCR is recommended.

ddx.dx: Detached nuclear lobe or apoptotic fragment
ddx.vs: Nuclear fragments have dense, homogeneous chromatin identical to the nucleus rather than stippled granular texture.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-gray, amorphous, and located at the periphery of the cytoplasm.
Engulfed bacteria appear as individual cocci or rods, often within vacuoles, rather than compact mulberry-like clusters.

ddx.dx: Anaplasma/Ehrlichia species other than A. phagocytophilum
ddx.vs: Ehrlichia ewingii also infects neutrophils and is morphologically identical, so species identification requires PCR.

3489.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維（reticulin）染色下，骨髓腔內黑色纖維呈密集、粗細不一且大量交叉的網狀，並呈平行流動狀排列包圍細胞，屬明顯骨髓纖維化（約 MF-2 至 MF-3），對應骨髓瘤合併纖維化。
features: Dense, diffuse network of black reticulin fibers with extensive intersections
Fibers coarse in areas and arranged in parallel, streaming bundles
Tumor cells entrapped within the fiber meshwork (pale tan background)
Bony trabecula at lower left (orange-brown) as orientation
Scattered dark brown granular cells/pigment deposits within the marrow
3489.describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows a markedly increased, diffuse and dense network of reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and focal coarse, parallel bundles surrounding the infiltrating cells. The adjacent bony trabecula is present at the lower left for orientation. The degree of fibrosis corresponds to at least WHO grade MF-2, with focal coarse fibers suggesting MF-3; a trichrome stain would confirm collagen deposition. Findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis accompanying plasma cell myeloma, which can cause a dry tap and underestimate plasma cells on aspirate.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes and a JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, whereas here the fibrosis accompanies a plasma cell infiltrate.
Carcinoma-associated fibrosis surrounds cohesive keratin-positive nests rather than individually entrapped CD138-positive plasma cells.
HCL shows a fine, evenly spaced reticulin mesh around cells with fried-egg cytology and is CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive.

3425.recognize_zh: 高倍下一顆雙葉中性球，箭頭所指細胞質邊緣有一小塊淡藍色、邊界模糊的斑塊，就是杜勒小體；細胞質顆粒細緻、無空泡，缺乏毒性顆粒。
features: Single mature neutrophil with bilobed nucleus and clumped chromatin
Small, ill-defined pale blue cytoplasmic inclusion at the cell periphery (arrow)
Remaining cytoplasm pale with fine specific granules; no toxic granulation or vacuoles
Surrounding red cells overlap in a thick region; a few platelets present
3425.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus. At the cytoplasmic periphery there is a small, poorly demarcated pale blue patch consistent with a Döhle body, representing retained rough endoplasmic reticulum. No toxic granulation or cytoplasmic vacuolization is identified. Findings are consistent with a Döhle body without toxic changes.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, sharper and present in most neutrophils together with macrothrombocytopenia.
A platelet or precipitate is granular or purple and sharply outlined, whereas a Döhle body is a homogeneous pale blue cytoplasmic zone.
Pelger-Huët refers to bilobed nuclei with coarse chromatin in most neutrophils, a nuclear rather than cytoplasmic finding; this cell's feature of interest is the cytoplasmic inclusion.

3169.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球幾乎都變成緻密、無中央淡染區的細胞，邊緣伸出數個不規則、長短不一的尖刺；少數為無刺的小圓緻密細胞，是典型的棘狀紅血球增多（acanthocytosis）。
features: Diffuse population of dense red cells lacking central pallor with 2-20 irregular spicules of unequal length
Spicules unevenly spaced, some with bulbous tips
Admixed small round dense cells without projections
Scattered small platelets
No leukocytes in this field
3169.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows diffuse poikilocytosis with most red cells being dense, lacking central pallor, and bearing irregularly spaced spicules of variable length. Small dense round cells without projections are admixed, and scattered platelets are present. Findings are consistent with severe acanthocytosis; etiologies include abetalipoproteinemia, neuroacanthocytosis syndromes, McLeod phenotype and spur cell anemia of advanced liver disease.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have numerous short, regular, evenly distributed projections around the entire circumference with preserved central pallor.
PK deficiency shows scattered small dense echinocytic cells mainly after splenectomy, rather than near-total replacement by acanthocytes, and is confirmed by enzyme assay.
Spherocytes are small dense round cells without spicules, whereas most cells here have irregular projections.

3105.recognize_zh: 大型白血球，核呈扭曲摺疊、染色質疏鬆呈網狀（lacy），胞質豐富灰藍帶細小顆粒與空泡感，是典型的成熟單核球。
features: Large leukocyte (about 2 times a red cell diameter)
Convoluted, folded nucleus with loose lacy chromatin
No nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue ground-glass cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dust and faint vacuolation
Irregular cell border
3105.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large mononuclear cell with a convoluted, folded nucleus and loose, lacy chromatin without nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and gray-blue with fine azurophilic granules and a slightly vacuolated ground-glass appearance. Findings are consistent with a normal mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have denser chromatin and clear to deep-blue cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells, without the gray ground-glass granularity.
Promonocytes have finer chromatin, subtle nucleoli, and more delicate nuclear folding.
Granulocytes have pink secondary granules and denser clumped chromatin in a kidney- or band-shaped nucleus.

2785.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆比紅血球大約兩倍的淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍，內含多顆粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核圓略凹、染色質成熟，是典型的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Lymphocyte about twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Low to moderate N:C ratio with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Numerous coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules scattered through the cytoplasm
Round to oval, eccentrically placed nucleus with a slight indentation
Mature, moderately condensed chromatin without visible nucleoli
2785.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules. The nucleus is round to oval, slightly indented and eccentrically placed, with mature condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable in this field. This is a large granular lymphocyte; a persistent absolute increase (typically >2 x 10^9/L for more than 6 months) with a clonal CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ phenotype would support T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinguished by transient course, polyclonal TCR and absence of STAT3 mutation.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGLs look the same but are surface CD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive, with clonality inferred from KIR restriction.
Granulocyte precursors have more numerous finer primary granules, a larger nucleus with nucleoli or Golgi hof, and lack the lymphoid clear pale-blue cytoplasm.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections, spongy chromatin and no azurophilic granules.

2721.recognize_zh: 中央聚集的兩三顆淋巴球細胞質寬、淡藍，核濃縮偏向一側，和旁邊的嗜中性球比較可見淋巴球數量偏多；這種細胞質豐富的淋巴球符合 LGL，但此倍率無法清楚看到嗜天青顆粒。
features: Lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Eccentric round-to-oval nuclei with condensed chromatin
Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules faint or not resolvable at this power
Segmented and band neutrophils interspersed
Small mature lymphocyte at lower left and smear artifact; normochromic red cells
2721.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and mature condensed chromatin, accompanied by segmented and band neutrophils and a small mature lymphocyte. Granularity of the lymphoid cytoplasm is not clearly resolved at this magnification. There are no blasts or overtly atypical cells in the field. Findings are suggestive of large granular lymphocytes in the context of NK-cell lymphocytosis, with high-power review, absolute counts and flow cytometry needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; T-LGL expresses surface CD3 and shows clonal TCR rearrangement, NK cells are surface CD3-negative and CD16/CD56-positive.
Reactive cells show basophilic cytoplasm with darker edges indenting around adjacent red cells and more variable size, without granules.
Plasmacytoid cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin rather than pale cytoplasm.

2593.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中箭頭所指的母細胞，細胞質邊緣有一塊淡染的核周空暈（perinuclear hof）把細胞核壓出凹陷，染色質細緻，旁邊另有兩顆母細胞，是t(8;21) AML骨髓母細胞的典型線索。
features: Three circulating blasts with high N:C ratios
Arrowed blast with a distinct pale perinuclear hof indenting the nucleus
Fine, dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm without definite Auer rods
Normocytic red cells in background with some overlap
2593.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm. The arrowed blast shows a distinct pale paranuclear hof that indents the nucleus. No Auer rods are identified at this resolution. Background red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with circulating myeloblasts with perinuclear hofs, a feature characteristic of AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); cytogenetic or molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells share the hof but have eccentric nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin and abundant deep-blue cytoplasm rather than fine blast chromatin.
Lymphoblasts usually lack a Golgi hof and granules and are MPO negative, though CD19 coexpression in t(8;21) necessitates full immunophenotyping.
Inv(16) blasts are myelomonocytic and accompanied by abnormal eosinophils with dark basophilic granules in the marrow, confirmed by CBFB::MYH11 testing.

2401.recognize_zh: 此視野中早幼粒細胞與骨髓細胞相對增多，大型早幼粒細胞具偏位圓核、明顯核周淡區與藍色顆粒細胞質，但旁邊仍有分節嗜中性球與後骨髓細胞，代表顆粒球正在同步再生，符合恢復中骨髓。
features: Several large promyelocytes with round eccentric nuclei, fine chromatin, basophilic granular cytoplasm and prominent paranuclear hof
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with indented nuclei
Segmented neutrophils and bands present, indicating ongoing maturation
Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Crenated red cells in the background (drying artifact); no Auer rods seen
2401.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a relative increase in large promyelocytes with round, eccentric nuclei, fine chromatin, basophilic granular cytoplasm, and prominent paranuclear hofs, accompanied by myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils. Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present, and background red cells are crenated. No Auer rods or dysplastic features are identified. Findings are consistent with a left-shifted, regenerating granulocytic population in a recovering marrow; clinical correlation with recent chemotherapy or growth factor therapy is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL cells are monotonous, often with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, and show a maturation arrest, whereas these promyelocytes coexist with mature neutrophils.
Plasma cells have clumped clock-face chromatin and agranular deep blue cytoplasm, while promyelocytes have fine chromatin and azurophilic granules.
Residual AML shows increased agranular blasts with aberrant immunophenotype on flow cytometry rather than a synchronized maturing granulocytic wave.

2145.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一個核被一道淺溝分隔、呈雙核或核分葉的前驅細胞（發育不良的紅血球系細胞），周圍則有多個染色質細緻、胞質深藍的大型芽細胞與核形不規則的紅血球前驅細胞，呈現芽細胞增加合併發育不良。
features: Arrowed cell with a nucleus divided by a cleft, suggesting binucleation/nuclear lobation of a dysplastic erythroid precursor
Increased large blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with irregular nuclear contours and nuclear budding
Scattered small lymphocytes and late normoblasts
Background red cells with poikilocytes and a smudged cell at right
2145.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased large blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The arrow highlights a precursor with a nucleus divided by a distinct cleft, consistent with binucleation or abnormal lobation, and additional erythroid precursors show irregular nuclear contours and budding. Late normoblasts and small lymphocytes are admixed. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic changes, compatible with AML with myelodysplasia-related changes when blast and multilineage dysplasia thresholds are confirmed.

ddx.vs: Differs by blast count below 20% on a 500-cell marrow differential.
PEL shows >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, whereas this field contains myeloblasts and mixed lineages.
Megaloblastic change can produce binucleate erythroid precursors but lacks increased myeloblasts.

2017.recognize_zh: 中倍下密集的小淋巴球背景中，散布數個淡粉紅色、界線模糊的小團細胞，細胞質豐富、核呈卵圓淡染，這些是類上皮組織球小叢（microgranulomas），沒有壞死或巨細胞，是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的關鍵線索。
features: Background of densely packed small mature lymphocytes
Multiple small, loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Histiocyte nuclei oval to reniform with vesicular chromatin
Clusters are ill-defined and non-necrotizing, without multinucleated giant cells
Scattered apoptotic debris within some clusters
No organisms or cysts identifiable at this magnification
2017.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at intermediate power shows a dense background of small mature lymphocytes interrupted by multiple small, loose, non-necrotizing clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei. Multinucleated giant cells and necrosis are absent, and organisms are not identified. Findings are consistent with the small epithelioid histiocyte clusters characteristic of toxoplasma lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are larger, tightly cohesive, well circumscribed and often contain giant cells, unlike these loose small clusters.
Mycobacterial granulomas are well formed with Langhans giant cells and caseous necrosis, and may show acid-fast bacilli.

ddx.dx: Lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma has diffuse effacement with atypical T cells and an aberrant T-cell phenotype, whereas the lymphocytes here are small and bland with preserved nodal features elsewhere.

1953.recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組化染色（抗體未標示）中，棕色陽性的小型淋巴細胞聚集成不規則的片狀與團塊，並散布在大片淡染、陽性細胞稀少的區域之間；上方可見玻璃樣化的血管。此分布呈地圖狀、不形成正常濾泡，需結合抗體名稱解讀。
features: Low-power IHC with positive brown-staining small cells forming irregular dense aggregates and sheets
Scattered positive cells dispersed within large pale areas that contain few positive cells
Geographic, irregular distribution without normal follicle/paracortex organization
Thick-walled hyalinized vessels at the upper center with positive cells clustered around them
Individual cell morphology not resolvable at this magnification
1953.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (antibody not labeled) of a lymph node shows positive small lymphoid cells arranged in irregular, geographic aggregates and sheets, including around thick-walled hyalinized vessels, with scattered positive cells in intervening large pale areas that are largely negative. Normal compartmentalization of follicles and paracortex is not evident. Because the antibody is not identified, the lineage of the positive population cannot be determined from this image alone; in context it most likely highlights a lymphoid subset in the disrupted architecture of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymph node with preserved compartments
ddx.vs: In reactive nodes B-cell and T-cell markers highlight well-defined round follicles and interfollicular zones respectively, rather than a geographic irregular pattern.
PTCL-NOS lacks the perivascular CD21-positive FDC expansion and TFH marker expression that support AITL.
THRLBCL shows only scattered isolated large CD20-positive cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background without B-cell aggregates.

1761.recognize_zh: 這是一張教學投影片：左側兩張臨床照片顯示皮膚上紅紫色、中央潰瘍結痂的結節，右側兩張組織切片為成片大型、細胞核不規則或腎形且核仁明顯的腫瘤細胞，組合起來符合原發性皮膚CD30陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Composite teaching slide titled 'CD30+ Primary Cutaneous ALCL' with two clinical photographs and two photomicrographs
Clinical photos: solitary erythematous to violaceous skin nodule with central ulceration and crust, and a larger ulcerated nodule with a small satellite lesion
Histology (upper right): large pleomorphic cells with irregular, reniform, and multilobated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli
Histology (lower right): diffuse sheet of large atypical cells with scattered smaller inflammatory cells
CD30 immunostain is not shown; the CD30 status is stated in the title only
1761.describe_en: This composite teaching slide shows clinical photographs of ulcerated, erythematous to violaceous cutaneous nodules alongside photomicrographs of a dermal infiltrate composed of sheets of large pleomorphic cells with irregular and kidney-shaped nuclei and prominent nucleoli. No CD30 immunostain is shown, and staging information is not provided. Primary cutaneous ALCL is defined by skin-limited disease at presentation with more than 75% CD30-positive large cells, and it is usually ALK negative. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous CD30-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma, with the caveat that systemic ALCL with secondary skin involvement must be excluded by staging.

ddx.vs: Lymphomatoid papulosis presents as recurrent, self-healing papules smaller than 2 cm with a wedge-shaped mixed infiltrate, whereas primary cutaneous ALCL forms larger persistent nodules with sheets of CD30+ cells.

ddx.dx: Systemic ALCL with secondary skin involvement
ddx.vs: Systemic ALCL involves nodes or other extracutaneous sites at staging and is often ALK positive, whereas primary cutaneous ALCL is skin-limited and usually ALK negative.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides with large cell transformation
ddx.vs: Transformed mycosis fungoides arises in a patient with prior patches and plaques and shows epidermotropism, whereas primary cutaneous ALCL arises de novo as nodules.

ddx.dx: Poorly differentiated carcinoma or melanoma of skin
ddx.vs: These are keratin or SOX10/S100 positive and CD30 negative.

1697.recognize_zh: 這是染色體示意圖：正常 9 號與 22 號，旁邊為衍生 9 號（變長，斷點 9q34）與衍生 22 號（變短，斷點 22q11）；變短的 der(22) 即費城染色體（Philadelphia chromosome），代表 t(9;22) BCR::ABL1。
features: Schematic G-banded ideogram comparing normal and derivative chromosomes 9 and 22
Breakpoint marked at 9q34 (ABL1) on the derivative chromosome 9, which is elongated
Breakpoint marked at 22q11 (BCR) on the derivative chromosome 22, which is shortened
Shortened der(22) labeled as the Philadelphia chromosome
Illustrates a reciprocal balanced translocation t(9;22)(q34;q11)
1697.describe_en: This is a schematic cytogenetic illustration rather than a morphologic image. It compares normal chromosomes 9 and 22 with their derivatives from the reciprocal translocation t(9;22)(q34;q11.2): the derivative 9 is lengthened by material from 22q, and the derivative 22 is shortened and designated the Philadelphia chromosome. The translocation fuses BCR on 22q11 with ABL1 on 9q34, creating a constitutively active tyrosine kinase. In ALL, the Philadelphia chromosome (usually p190 BCR::ABL1) defines a high-risk subtype treated with tyrosine kinase inhibitors, and it is the defining lesion of CML (usually p210).

ddx.vs: Same translocation, but CML typically carries the p210 transcript and presents with a left-shifted granulocytosis and basophilia rather than a lymphoblast population.
Has a similar kinase-activated gene-expression profile but lacks t(9;22) on karyotype/FISH, instead carrying CRLF2, JAK or ABL-class rearrangements.
Complex or masked translocations may show no visible Ph chromosome on karyotype and require FISH or RT-PCR for BCR::ABL1.

1633.recognize_zh: H&E 淋巴結副皮質區（T 區）：大量小而深染的圓形淋巴球，夾雜較大、核淡且卵圓的細胞（免疫母細胞、組織球或樹突狀細胞），並可見斜行、內皮細胞肥厚的高內皮小靜脈（HEV），呈現「斑駁」的混合外觀。
features: Mixed population of small, dark, round lymphocytes and larger pale cells
Larger cells with oval vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli (immunoblasts, histiocytes, dendritic cells)
High endothelial venules with plump cuboidal endothelium coursing obliquely
Mottled appearance without follicle formation in this field
No sheets of atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells
1633.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows paracortical (interfollicular) tissue composed of numerous small round lymphocytes admixed with scattered larger cells with pale oval nuclei and small nucleoli, imparting a mottled appearance. High endothelial venules with plump endothelial cells traverse the field. Follicles are not present in this field, and there are no sheets of atypical large cells or diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells. Findings are consistent with normal or mildly reactive paracortex (T zone).

ddx.vs: PTCL shows cytologic atypia with irregular medium-to-large T cells, effacement of architecture and aberrant T-cell antigen loss.
AITL shows arborizing HEV proliferation with clear-cell TFH cells, expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks and effaced architecture.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with CD30/CD15 positivity and an eosinophil-rich background would be present.
Shows a more marked immunoblastic proliferation, sometimes mimicking lymphoma, but with preserved sinuses and polyclonal cells.

1441.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片組合圖，重點是紅血球系異常增生：可見巨大、胞質深藍的類巨母紅血球（megaloblastoid）前驅細胞、核分葉或出芽的紅血球母細胞及有絲分裂；此圖只顯示紅系異型性，環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）必須用鐵染色才能確認，本圖看不到。
features: Four-panel composite of bone marrow aspirate fields
Erythroid precursors with megaloblastoid features: large size, fine open chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Dyserythropoietic nuclear changes including multilobated or irregular nuclear contours and nuclear budding
Mitotic figure and binucleate-appearing erythroid cells
Admixed granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes; no Prussian blue stain in this image
1441.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate fields shows erythroid precursors with megaloblastoid maturation, including large erythroblasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Several erythroid cells show dyserythropoietic changes such as irregular, multilobated or budding nuclei, and a mitotic figure is present. Granulocytic precursors are also seen. These dyserythropoietic features are compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm; demonstration of ring sideroblasts (at least 15%, or at least 5% with SF3B1 mutation) requires an iron stain, which is not shown.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and it corrects with vitamin replacement.
CDA presents in young patients with binucleate erythroblasts (type II) or internuclear bridging (type I) and lacks ring sideroblasts or clonal markers.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires more than 80% erythroid precursors with at least 30% proerythroblasts, which is not established in these selected fields.

ddx.dx: Alcohol, copper deficiency or drug-induced dyserythropoiesis
ddx.vs: These reversible causes can produce vacuolated precursors and ring sideroblasts and are excluded by history and laboratory testing.

61857.recognize_zh: 視野中央有兩顆紅血球一端拉長成單一尾巴、呈淚滴狀（teardrop cell／dacrocyte），周圍紅血球大小不一，是骨髓纖維化或骨髓浸潤常見的線索。
features: Two red cells in the center with a single tapered tail, forming classic teardrop shapes (dacrocytes)
Moderate anisocytosis with some larger, round red cells lacking central pallor
Occasional red cells with small, sharply defined central pallor or target-like appearance
Scattered platelets of normal size
No nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
61857.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with moderate anisocytosis and mild poikilocytosis. Two dacrocytes with single tapered tails are present in the center of the field, and occasional red cells show target-like central staining. Platelets are present and of normal size; no leukocytes or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with teardrop cells; when numerous and accompanied by leukoerythroblastosis they suggest myelofibrosis or marrow infiltration.

ddx.vs: Artifactual tails all point in the same direction along the smear axis, whereas true dacrocytes are randomly oriented as these two cells are.
Schistocytes are small fragments with sharp angles or helmet shapes rather than an intact cell with a single smooth rounded tail.
Elliptocytes are symmetrically elongated at both ends, without a single tapered tail.

97.recognize_zh: 抹片可見明顯大小不等與異形紅血球（小球、靶形、碎片及淚滴形細胞）並有有核紅血球；HPLC 顯示 HbF 約 95%、幾乎無 HbA，而父母 HPLC 為 HbA2 升高（本圖 4.6%）的帶因者型態，符合 β 型重型海洋性貧血（thalassemia major）。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, fragmented cells, and teardrop cells
Circulating nucleated red blood cell adjacent to a small lymphocyte
HPLC (child): HbF 95.0% with HbA2 3.9% and virtually absent HbA0 peak
HPLC (parent): HbA0 dominant peak with raised HbA2 4.6% and HbF 1.0%, consistent with beta-thalassemia trait
HBB Sanger sequencing: overlapping (double) peaks beginning at a defined position, indicating heterozygous frameshift mutations
Gel electrophoresis of PCR products: a common control band in all lanes with additional smaller mutation-specific bands in selected lanes
97.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, fragmented red cells, teardrop forms, and circulating nucleated red cells. Hemoglobin HPLC on the child shows HbF of 95.0% with HbA2 3.9% and essentially no HbA, whereas the parental HPLC shows a predominant HbA peak with an elevated HbA2 of 4.6%, consistent with beta-thalassemia trait. HBB sequencing chromatograms show superimposed double peaks after codon 8 and after codons 41/42, suggestive of heterozygous frameshift mutations (such as codons 8/9 +G and codons 41/42 -TTCT); allele-specific PCR gel shows mutation-specific bands in some lanes alongside a control band. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major (compound heterozygous/homozygous beta0-thalassemia) inherited from carrier parents.

ddx.vs: HPFH shows high HbF with normal red cell morphology, no significant anemia, and no HbA2 elevation in carriers.
HPLC would show a large HbE peak co-eluting in the A2 window (typically >25%) together with HbF, rather than HbF with a small A2.
HbH disease shows fast-moving HbH/Bart's peaks and HbH inclusions on supravital stain with low-normal HbA2, not near-total HbF.
Iron deficiency produces microcytic hypochromic cells with pencil cells but normal HbF, low-normal HbA2, and low ferritin, without nucleated RBCs or hepatosplenomegaly in infancy.

33.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見小球性低色素紅血球、中央淡染區擴大、明顯大小不均及鉛筆狀細胞（pencil cell）；骨髓鐵染色（Prussian blue）顆粒內可染鐵為 0，另有舌乳頭萎縮的臨床照片，符合缺鐵性貧血。
features: Microcytic, hypochromic red cells with enlarged central pallor, some reduced to a thin rim of hemoglobin
Marked anisocytosis (high RDW pattern) with poikilocytosis including elongated pencil cells/elliptocytes and occasional teardrop and fragmented forms
Platelets normal to increased in number
Small lymphocytes serve as size reference; no nucleated red cells or basophilic stippling evident
Bone marrow aspirate Prussian blue: absent stainable iron (grade 0) in particles, contrasted with a 0 to 4+ grading panel
Clinical photo: smooth, depapillated areas of the tongue (atrophic glossitis)
33.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show a microcytic, hypochromic red cell population with enlarged central pallor, marked anisocytosis and poikilocytosis including pencil cells, elliptocytes and occasional teardrop and fragmented forms; in the most severe field red cells appear as thin rims of hemoglobin. Leukocytes are unremarkable and platelets are adequate to mildly increased. A Prussian blue stain of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows no stainable iron (grade 0), illustrated alongside a reference panel grading marrow iron from 0 to 4+. A clinical photograph shows atrophic glossitis. Findings are consistent with iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait shows uniform microcytosis with normal RDW, target cells and basophilic stippling, a high RBC count and preserved marrow iron.
Anemia of chronic disease is usually normocytic to mildly microcytic with little anisocytosis and has increased macrophage iron with reduced sideroblasts.
Sideroblastic anemia shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and increased marrow iron with ring sideroblasts on Prussian blue.
Lead toxicity features coarse basophilic stippling and ring sideroblasts rather than absent marrow iron.

4001.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片同一視野內有多顆中性球、一顆核折疊呈腎形的單核球，以及左側一顆胞質豐富灰藍的大型單核樣細胞，呈白血球增多並伴單核球增加；型態本身不具特異性，須配合孩童年齡、單核球 ≥1×10^9/L 與 RAS 路徑突變診斷 JMML。
features: Increased white cells in a single field: several segmented neutrophils and bands
Monocyte with folded, reniform nucleus and gray-blue cytoplasm (center bottom)
Large mononuclear cell at left with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and irregular nucleus, suggestive of an immature monocyte
Neutrophils show mostly normal granulation; one with ring-like nuclear configuration
Red cells largely normocytic with occasional stomatocytes; blasts not clearly identified
4001.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis with several segmented neutrophils and bands, a mature monocyte with a folded reniform nucleus, and a larger monocytoid cell with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm consistent with an immature monocyte. Neutrophil granulation is largely preserved, and one neutrophil has a ring-like nucleus. Red cells are mostly normocytic with occasional stomatocytes, and no definite blasts are seen in this field. In a young child, the combination of neutrophilia and monocytosis with immature monocytoid forms is consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, which requires an absolute monocyte count of at least 1 x 10^9/L and genetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: CML shows a left-shifted myeloid bulge with basophilia and myelocyte peak rather than prominent monocytosis, and is defined by BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: Infection-associated (e.g., EBV, CMV) monocytosis in infancy
ddx.vs: Reactive monocytosis lacks fetal hemoglobin elevation, GM-CSF hypersensitivity and RAS-pathway mutations and resolves with the infection.
AML requires at least 20% blasts including promonocytes, whereas JMML has fewer than 20% blasts.
